WITH toy_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_purchase_timestamp AS date, oi.price
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'toys' 
    AND date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-29'
),
daily_sales AS (
    SELECT date(date) AS sales_date, SUM(price) AS total_sales
    FROM toy_orders
    GROUP BY date(date)
),
linreg AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS n,
        SUM(CAST(julianday(sales_date) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INT)) AS sum_x,
        SUM(total_sales) AS sum_y,
        SUM(CAST(julianday(sales_date) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INT) * total_sales) AS sum_xy,
        SUM((CAST(julianday(sales_date) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INT)) * (CAST(julianday(sales_date) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INT))) AS sum_x2
    FROM daily_sales
),
predict_dates(date) AS (
    VALUES ('2018-12-05'),('2018-12-06'),('2018-12-07'),('2018-12-08'),
           ('2018-12-03'),('2018-12-04'),('2018-12-09'),('2018-12-10')
),
predicted_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        pd.date, 
        lr.n, lr.sum_x, lr.sum_y, lr.sum_xy, lr.sum_x2,
        CAST(julianday(pd.date) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INT) AS x
    FROM predict_dates pd CROSS JOIN linreg lr
),
predicted_toy_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        date,
        (
            (sum_xy - (sum_x * sum_y) / n) / (sum_x2 - (sum_x * sum_x) / n)
        ) AS slope,
        (
            (sum_y - (
                (sum_xy - (sum_x * sum_y) / n) / (sum_x2 - (sum_x * sum_x) / n)
            ) * sum_x) / n
        ) AS intercept,
        x,
        (
            (
                (sum_xy - (sum_x * sum_y) / n) / (sum_x2 - (sum_x * sum_x) / n)
            ) * x + 
            ((sum_y - (
                (sum_xy - (sum_x * sum_y) / n) / (sum_x2 - (sum_x * sum_x) / n)
            ) * sum_x) / n)
        ) AS predicted_sales
    FROM predicted_sales
),
window_center_dates AS (
    SELECT '2018-12-05' AS target_date, '2018-12-03' AS win_start, '2018-12-07' AS win_end UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-06', '2018-12-04', '2018-12-08' UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-07', '2018-12-05', '2018-12-09' UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-08', '2018-12-06', '2018-12-10'
),
window_data AS (
    SELECT wc.target_date, pts.date, pts.predicted_sales
    FROM window_center_dates wc
    JOIN predicted_toy_sales pts ON pts.date BETWEEN wc.win_start AND wc.win_end
),
moving_avgs AS (
    SELECT target_date, AVG(predicted_sales) AS moving_avg
    FROM window_data
    GROUP BY target_date
)
SELECT SUM(moving_avg) AS sum_5day_moving_averages
FROM moving_avgs;

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_totals AS (
    SELECT
        do.customer_id,
        do.order_id,
        do.order_purchase_timestamp,
        SUM(oi.price + IFNULL(oi.freight_value,0)) AS order_amount
    FROM delivered_orders do
    JOIN order_items oi ON do.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY do.customer_id, do.order_id, do.order_purchase_timestamp
),
rfm_base AS (
    SELECT
        ot.customer_id,
        COUNT(ot.order_id) AS frequency,
        SUM(ot.order_amount) AS monetary,
        MAX(ot.order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_order_ts
    FROM order_totals ot
    GROUP BY ot.customer_id
),
recency_calc AS (
    SELECT
        rb.*,
        JULIANDAY((SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) FROM delivered_orders)) - JULIANDAY(rb.last_order_ts) AS recency
    FROM rfm_base rb
),
rfm_scores AS (
    SELECT
        rc.customer_id,
        rc.frequency,
        rc.monetary,
        rc.recency,
        -- Recency: lower is better (1 = most recent, 5 = least recent)
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY rc.recency ASC) AS recency_score,
        -- Frequency: higher is better (1 = most frequent, 5 = least frequent)
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY rc.frequency DESC) AS frequency_score,
        -- Monetary: higher is better (1 = highest spending, 5 = lowest)
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY rc.monetary DESC) AS monetary_score
    FROM recency_calc rc
),
rfm_segments AS (
    SELECT
        rs.*,
        (rs.frequency_score + rs.monetary_score) AS fm_sum,
        CASE
            WHEN rs.recency_score = 1 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN (rs.recency_score IN (4,5)) AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can\'t Lose Them'
            WHEN (rs.recency_score IN (4,5)) AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN (rs.recency_score IN (4,5)) AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN (rs.recency_score IN (2,3)) AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN rs.recency_score = 3 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN rs.recency_score = 1 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (rs.recency_score = 1 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
                 OR (rs.recency_score = 2 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN rs.recency_score = 1 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN rs.recency_score = 2 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN rs.recency_score = 3 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS rfm_segment
    FROM rfm_scores rs
),
avg_sales_per_order AS (
    SELECT
        rs.customer_id,
        rs.rfm_segment,
        rs.monetary * 1.0 / rs.frequency AS avg_sales_per_order
    FROM rfm_segments rs
    WHERE rs.frequency > 0
)
SELECT
    rfm_segment,
    COUNT(customer_id) AS num_customers,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_sales_per_order),2) AS avg_sales_per_order,
    MIN(avg_sales_per_order) AS min_avg_sales,
    MAX(avg_sales_per_order) AS max_avg_sales
FROM avg_sales_per_order
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY 
    CASE rfm_segment
       WHEN 'Champions' THEN 1
       WHEN 'Loyal Customers' THEN 2
       WHEN 'Potential Loyalists' THEN 3
       WHEN 'Recent Users' THEN 4
       WHEN 'Needs Attention' THEN 5
       WHEN 'Promising' THEN 6
       WHEN 'Can''t Lose Them' THEN 7
       WHEN 'About to Sleep' THEN 8
       WHEN 'Hibernating' THEN 9
       WHEN 'Lost' THEN 10
       WHEN 'Price Sensitive' THEN 11
       ELSE 99
    END;

WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS num_orders,
    MIN(DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS first_order_date,
    MAX(DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS last_order_date
  FROM orders o
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
customer_payments AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    oi.order_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(op.payment_value), 0) AS total_payment
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY o.customer_id, oi.order_id
),
customer_avg_payment AS (
  SELECT
    cp.customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cp.order_id) AS num_orders,
    SUM(cp.total_payment) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cp.order_id) AS avg_payment_per_order
  FROM customer_payments cp
  GROUP BY cp.customer_id
),
customer_lifespan_weeks AS (
  SELECT
    co.customer_id,
    co.num_orders,
    co.first_order_date,
    co.last_order_date,
    CASE
      WHEN julianday(co.last_order_date) - julianday(co.first_order_date) < 7 THEN 1.0
      ELSE ROUND((julianday(co.last_order_date) - julianday(co.first_order_date))/7.0, 2)
    END AS lifespan_weeks
  FROM customer_orders co
)
SELECT
  ca.customer_id,
  ca.num_orders,
  ROUND(ca.avg_payment_per_order, 2) AS avg_payment_per_order,
  clw.lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_avg_payment ca
JOIN customer_lifespan_weeks clw ON ca.customer_id = clw.customer_id
ORDER BY ca.avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH career_spans AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    ROUND(ABS(CAST(strftime('%Y', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', debut) AS INTEGER)), 2) AS year_diff,
    ROUND(ABS(CAST(strftime('%m', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%m', debut) AS INTEGER)) / 12.0, 2) AS month_diff,
    ROUND(ABS(CAST(strftime('%d', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%d', debut) AS INTEGER)) / 365.0, 2) AS day_diff
  FROM player
  WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND final_game IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(year_diff + month_diff + day_diff), 2) AS avg_career_span_years
FROM career_spans;

WITH max_values AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(g) AS max_games,
    MAX(r) AS max_runs,
    MAX(h) AS max_hits,
    MAX(hr) AS max_home_runs
  FROM batting
),
max_players AS (
  SELECT player_id, 'Games Played' AS category, g AS value
  FROM batting, max_values
  WHERE g = max_values.max_games
  UNION ALL
  SELECT player_id, 'Runs' AS category, r AS value
  FROM batting, max_values
  WHERE r = max_values.max_runs
  UNION ALL
  SELECT player_id, 'Hits' AS category, h AS value
  FROM batting, max_values
  WHERE h = max_values.max_hits
  UNION ALL
  SELECT player_id, 'Home Runs' AS category, hr AS value
  FROM batting, max_values
  WHERE hr = max_values.max_home_runs
)
SELECT
  p.name_given,
  m.category,
  m.value
FROM max_players m
JOIN player p ON m.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY m.category

WITH abakan_airports AS (
    SELECT airport_code
    FROM airports_data
    WHERE city = 'Abakan'
),
routes AS (
    SELECT 
        f.departure_airport AS airport1,
        f.arrival_airport AS airport2
    FROM flights f
    WHERE f.departure_airport IN (SELECT airport_code FROM abakan_airports)
       OR f.arrival_airport IN (SELECT airport_code FROM abakan_airports)
),
unique_routes AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN a1.city < a2.city THEN a1.city ELSE a2.city END AS city1,
        CASE WHEN a1.city < a2.city THEN a2.city ELSE a1.city END AS city2,
        a1.airport_code AS airport1, a2.airport_code AS airport2,
        a1.latitude_deg AS lat1, a1.longitude_deg AS lon1,
        a2.latitude_deg AS lat2, a2.longitude_deg AS lon2
    FROM routes r
    JOIN airports_data a1 ON r.airport1 = a1.airport_code
    JOIN airports_data a2 ON r.airport2 = a2.airport_code
),
city_pairs AS (
    SELECT city1, city2, lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2
    FROM unique_routes
    GROUP BY city1, city2
),
distances AS (
    SELECT
        city1, city2,
        2 * 6371 * 
        ASIN(
            SQRT(
                POWER(SIN(RADIANS((lat2 - lat1) / 2)), 2) +
                COS(RADIANS(lat1)) * COS(RADIANS(lat2)) *
                POWER(SIN(RADIANS((lon2 - lon1) / 2)), 2)
            )
        ) AS distance_km
    FROM city_pairs
    WHERE city1 = 'Abakan' OR city2 = 'Abakan'
)
SELECT MAX(distance_km) AS longest_route_km
FROM distances;

WITH city_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN ad1.city < ad2.city THEN ad1.city ELSE ad2.city END AS city1,
    CASE WHEN ad1.city < ad2.city THEN ad2.city ELSE ad1.city END AS city2,
    ad1.latitude AS lat1, ad1.longitude AS lon1,
    ad2.latitude AS lat2, ad2.longitude AS lon2
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airports_data ad1 ON f.departure_airport = ad1.airport_code
  JOIN airports_data ad2 ON f.arrival_airport = ad2.airport_code
  WHERE ad1.city != ad2.city
),
city_pair_distances AS (
  -- Compute distance for each flight, normalized city pair
  SELECT
    city1,
    city2,
    2 * 6371 * 
      ASIN(
        SQRT(
          POW(SIN(RADIANS(lat2 - lat1) / 2), 2)
          + COS(RADIANS(lat1)) * COS(RADIANS(lat2))
          * POW(SIN(RADIANS(lon2 - lon1) / 2), 2)
        )
      ) AS distance
  FROM city_pairs
),
avg_citypair_distance AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    AVG(distance) AS avg_distance
  FROM city_pair_distances
  GROUP BY city1, city2
),
distance_ranges AS (
  SELECT
    city1,
    city2,
    avg_distance,
    CASE
      WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0'
      WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000'
      ELSE '6000+'
    END AS distance_range
  FROM avg_citypair_distance
),
range_counts AS (
  SELECT
    distance_range,
    COUNT(*) AS pair_count
  FROM distance_ranges
  GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT 
  distance_range,
  pair_count
FROM range_counts
WHERE pair_count = (SELECT MIN(pair_count) FROM range_counts);

WITH motorcycle_collisions AS (
  SELECT c.case_id
  FROM collisions c
  WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
),
motorcycle_parties AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.case_id,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(p.party_safety_equipment_1) LIKE '%helmet%' OR LOWER(p.party_safety_equipment_2) LIKE '%helmet%' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS helmeted
  FROM parties p
  WHERE LOWER(p.statewide_vehicle_type) LIKE '%motorcycle%'
),
helmet_grouped_collisions AS (
  SELECT mp.helmeted, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.case_id) AS collision_count
  FROM motorcycle_parties mp
  JOIN motorcycle_collisions mc ON mp.case_id = mc.case_id
  GROUP BY mp.helmeted
),
helmeted_fatalities AS (
  SELECT mp.helmeted, COUNT(*) AS fatality_count
  FROM victims v
  JOIN motorcycle_parties mp 
    ON v.case_id = mp.case_id AND v.party_number = mp.party_number
  WHERE LOWER(v.victim_role) IN ('driver', 'passenger')
    AND v.victim_degree_of_injury = 'Killed'
  GROUP BY mp.helmeted
)
SELECT 
  hgc.helmeted,
  hgc.collision_count,
  COALESCE(hf.fatality_count, 0) AS fatality_count,
  ROUND(
    CAST(COALESCE(hf.fatality_count, 0) AS FLOAT) / hgc.collision_count * 100, 
    2
  ) AS fatality_rate_percentage
FROM helmet_grouped_collisions hgc
LEFT JOIN helmeted_fatalities hf ON hgc.helmeted = hf.helmeted
ORDER BY hgc.helmeted DESC

WITH cause_year_counts AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y', date) AS year,
    cause,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM collisions
  GROUP BY year, cause
),
top2_causes_per_year AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    cause,
    cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY cnt DESC, cause) AS rn
  FROM cause_year_counts
),
year_top2_causes AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    GROUP_CONCAT(cause, '|') AS top2_causes
  FROM top2_causes_per_year
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY year
),
partners AS (
  SELECT
    a.year,
    a.top2_causes
  FROM year_top2_causes a
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM year_top2_causes b
    WHERE b.year <> a.year AND b.top2_causes = a.top2_causes
  )
)
SELECT year
FROM partners;

WITH factor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y', collision_date) AS year,
    primary_collision_factor_violation_category,
    COUNT(*) AS incident_count
  FROM collisions
  GROUP BY year, primary_collision_factor_violation_category
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y', collision_date) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS total_incidents
  FROM collisions
  GROUP BY year
),
factor_shares AS (
  SELECT
    f.year,
    f.primary_collision_factor_violation_category AS category,
    1.0 * f.incident_count / t.total_incidents * 100 AS pct_share
  FROM factor_counts f
  JOIN total_counts t
    ON f.year = t.year
)
, top_category_2021 AS (
  SELECT category
  FROM factor_shares
  WHERE year = '2021'
  ORDER BY pct_share DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  fs2021.pct_share - fs2011.pct_share AS percentage_point_decrease
FROM factor_shares fs2021
JOIN factor_shares fs2011
  ON fs2021.category = fs2011.category
JOIN top_category_2021 tc
  ON fs2021.category = tc.category
WHERE fs2021.year = '2021' AND fs2011.year = '2011'
;

SELECT 
    m1.Match_ID, 
    w1.Name AS Wrestler1, 
    w2.Name AS Wrestler2
FROM Matches m1
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m1.Wrestler1_ID = w1.Wrestler_ID
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m1.Wrestler2_ID = w2.Wrestler_ID
WHERE m1.Title = 'NXT'
  AND m1.Title_Change = 0
  AND m1.Match_Duration = (
      SELECT MIN(m2.Match_Duration)
      FROM Matches m2
      WHERE m2.Title = 'NXT'
        AND m2.Title_Change = 0
  );

SELECT 
    p.player_name, 
    SUM(b.bowler_runs) * 1.0 / COUNT(w.wicket_id) AS bowling_average
FROM 
    wicket_taken w
JOIN 
    ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id 
        AND w.inning_no = b.inning_no 
        AND w.over_id = b.over_id 
        AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
JOIN 
    player p ON w.bowler = p.player_id
GROUP BY 
    w.bowler, p.player_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(w.wicket_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH striker_match_runs AS (
  SELECT
    bb.striker,
    bb.match_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
  FROM
    ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  GROUP BY
    bb.striker,
    bb.match_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) AS avg_total_runs
FROM striker_match_runs
WHERE total_runs > 50;

WITH player_runs AS (
  SELECT 
    b.match_id, 
    b.striker AS player_id, 
    p.team_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  JOIN player_match p ON b.match_id = p.match_id AND b.striker = p.player_id
  GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker, p.team_id
),
lost_teams AS (
  SELECT 
    m.match_id, 
    CASE 
      WHEN m.team_1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team_2 
      WHEN m.team_2 = m.match_winner THEN m.team_1 
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS lost_team_id
  FROM match m
  WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT pl.player_name
FROM player_runs pr
JOIN lost_teams lt ON pr.match_id = lt.match_id AND pr.team_id = lt.lost_team_id
JOIN player pl ON pr.player_id = pl.player_id
WHERE pr.runs >= 100

WITH season5_matches AS (
  SELECT match_id
  FROM match
  WHERE season = 5
),
player_runs AS (
  SELECT
    pm.player_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played
  FROM player_match pm
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON pm.match_id = bs.match_id AND pm.player_id = bs.striker
  WHERE pm.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
  GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_averages AS (
  SELECT
    pr.player_id,
    pr.total_runs * 1.0 / pr.matches_played AS batting_average
  FROM player_runs pr
  WHERE pr.matches_played > 0
)
SELECT
  p.player_name,
  pa.batting_average
FROM player_averages pa
JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY pa.batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH player_totals AS (
    SELECT
        pm.player_id,
        p.country,
        SUM(bb.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN player p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
    LEFT JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON pm.match_id = bb.match_id AND pm.player_id = bb.striker_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, p.country
    HAVING matches_played > 0
),
player_averages AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        country,
        CAST(total_runs AS FLOAT) / matches_played AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_totals
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        AVG(avg_runs_per_match) AS country_batting_average
    FROM player_averages
    GROUP BY country
)
SELECT
    country,
    country_batting_average
FROM country_averages
ORDER BY country_batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT
        bb.match_id,
        bb.innings_no,
        bb.over_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) + SUM(COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs,
        MIN(bb.bowler) AS bowler -- bowler per over (first bowler found for the over)
    FROM
        ball_by_ball bb
        LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
            AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
            AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
            AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id
            AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
            AND bb.over_id = er.over_id
            AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY
        bb.match_id,
        bb.innings_no,
        bb.over_id
),
max_over_per_match AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        over_id,
        bowler,
        total_runs
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY match_id
                ORDER BY total_runs DESC, innings_no, over_id
            ) AS rn
        FROM over_runs
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(total_runs), 2) AS avg_highest_over_total
FROM
    max_over_per_match;

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT
        bb.match_id,
        bb.inning,
        bb.over_id,
        bb.bowler_id,
        SUM(bs.runs) + IFNULL(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) AS total_runs
    FROM
        ball_by_ball bb
        LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY

  FROM olist_geolocation
  GROUP BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix
),
ordered_cities AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    LAG(avg_lat) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, avg_lat, avg_lng
    ) AS prev_lat,
    LAG(avg_lng) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, avg_lat, avg_lng
    ) AS prev_lng,
    LAG(geolocation_state) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, avg_lat, avg_lng
    ) AS prev_state,
    LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, avg_lat, avg_lng
    ) AS prev_city,
    LAG(geolocation_zip_code_prefix) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, avg_lat, avg_lng
    ) AS prev_zip
  FROM city_coords
),
distances AS (
  SELECT
    geolocation_state,
    geolocation_city,
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
    avg_lat,
    avg_lng,
    prev_state,
    prev_city,
    prev_zip,
    prev_lat,
    prev_lng,
    CASE 
      WHEN prev_lat IS NOT NULL AND prev_lng IS NOT NULL THEN
        6371 * acos(
          cos(radians(avg_lat)) * cos(radians(prev_lat)) *
          cos(radians(prev_lng) - radians(avg_lng)) +
          sin(radians(avg_lat)) * sin(radians(prev_lat))
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS distance_km
  FROM ordered_cities
)
SELECT
  prev_state AS city1_state,
  prev_city AS city1_city,
  prev_zip AS city1_zip,
  prev_lat AS city1_lat,
  prev_lng AS city1_lng,
  geolocation_state AS city2_state,
  geolocation_city AS city2_city,

FROM distances

ORDER BY distance_km DESC

),
monthly_proj_2021 AS (

        CASE
            WHEN amt_2019 = 0 AND amt_2020 = 0 THEN 0
            WHEN amt_2019 = 0 THEN amt_2020 -- If no 2019 data, default to 2020
            ELSE (((amt_2020 - amt_2019)*1.0 / NULLIF(amt_2019,0)) * amt_2020) + amt_2020
        END AS proj_2021
    FROM monthly_combined
),

  JOIN artists ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
  LEFT JOIN invoice_items ii ON al.AlbumId = ii.AlbumId
  GROUP BY al.AlbumId, ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
),
Artist_Sales AS (
  SELECT
    ArtistId,
    ArtistName,
    SUM(Sales) AS TotalSales
  FROM Album_Sales
  GROUP BY ArtistId, ArtistName

Top_And_Bottom_Artists AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName, TotalSales
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ArtistId,
      ArtistName,
      TotalSales,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSales DESC, ArtistName ASC) AS rn_top,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSales ASC, ArtistName ASC) AS rn_bottom
    FROM Artist_Sales
  )
  WHERE rn_top = 1 OR rn_bottom = 1
),

),
Customer_Artist_Spend AS (
  SELECT
    c.CustomerId,
    c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS CustomerName,

  FROM customers c

  JOIN invoice_items ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
  JOIN albums al ON ii.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
  JOIN Top_And_Bottom_Artists tba ON al.ArtistId = tba.ArtistId
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId, tba.ArtistId

      MAX(CASE WHEN ArtistName = (SELECT ArtistName FROM Top_And_Bottom_Artists ORDER BY TotalSales ASC, ArtistName ASC LIMIT 1) THEN AvgSpend END)

  FROM Artist_Avg_Spend

sales_top3_2021 AS (
    SELECT f.division, f.product_code, s.sold_quantity
    FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly s
    JOIN hardware_dim_product p ON s.product_code = p.product_code
    JOIN top3_per_division f ON f.product_code = s.product_code AND f.division = p.division
    WHERE s.fiscal_year = 2021
)
SELECT 
    division, 
    ROUND(AVG(sold_quantity), 2) AS avg_quantity_sold
FROM sales_top3_2021
GROUP BY division
ORDER BY division

WITH US_cities_sales_qtr AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_desc, t.calendar_year, 
         SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE co.country_iso_code = 'US' 
    AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('Q4 2019', 'Q4 2020')
    AND s.promo_id = 0
  GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_desc, t.calendar_year
),
City_sales_growth AS (
  SELECT cust_city,
         SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_desc = 'Q4 2019' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_19,
         SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_desc = 'Q4 2020' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_20
  FROM US_cities_sales_qtr
  GROUP BY cust_city
  HAVING sales_19 > 0 AND sales_20 >= 1.2 * sales_19
),
Qualified_city_sales AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_desc, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS prod_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_iso_code = 'US'
    AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('Q4 2019', 'Q4 2020')
    AND s.promo_id = 0
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM City_sales_growth)
  GROUP BY c.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
Product_city_rank AS (
  SELECT prod_id, SUM(prod_sales) AS total_sales,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(prod_sales) DESC) AS rnk,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
  FROM Qualified_city_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
),
Top_20p_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id
  FROM Product_city_rank
  WHERE rnk <= CAST(cnt * 0.2 AS INTEGER) AND total_sales > 0
),
Product_share_by_qtr AS (
  SELECT qs.prod_id, qs.calendar_quarter_desc,
         SUM(qs.prod_sales) AS top_prod_sales,
         SUM(SUM(qs.prod_sales)) OVER (PARTITION BY qs.calendar_quarter_desc) AS total_sales_in_qtr
  FROM Qualified_city_sales qs
  WHERE qs.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM Top_20p_products)
  GROUP BY qs.prod_id, qs.calendar_quarter_desc
),
Share_change AS (
  SELECT psbq.prod_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN psbq.calendar_quarter_desc = 'Q4 2019' THEN ROUND(psbq.top_prod_sales * 1.0 / psbq.total_sales_in_qtr, 5) END) AS share_2019,
         MAX(CASE WHEN psbq.calendar_quarter_desc = 'Q4 2020' THEN ROUND(psbq.top_prod_sales * 1.0 / psbq.total_sales_in_qtr, 5) END) AS share_2020
  FROM Product_share_by_qtr psbq
  GROUP BY psbq.prod_id
)
SELECT p.prod_id, p.prod_name, sc.share_2019, sc.share_2020,
       (sc.share_2020 - sc.share_2019) AS share_change
FROM Share_change sc
JOIN products p ON sc.prod_id = p.prod_id
WHERE sc.share_2019 IS NOT NULL AND sc.share_2020 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY share_change DESC

WITH fr AS (
    SELECT country_id FROM countries WHERE country_iso_code = 'FR'
),
filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id, 
        strftime('%Y', s.time_id) AS sales_year, 
        strftime('%m', s.time_id) AS sales_month, 
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS amount_sold
    FROM sales s
    JOIN promotions pr ON s.promo_id = pr.promo_id
    JOIN channels c ON s.channel_id = c.channel_id
    WHERE s.cust_id IN (SELECT country_id FROM fr)
      AND pr.promo_total_id = 1
      AND c.channel_total_id = 1
      AND (strftime('%Y', s.time_id) = '2019' OR strftime('%Y', s.time_id) = '2020')
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, sales_year, sales_month
),
pivoted_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id, 
        sales_month,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = '2019' THEN amount_sold ELSE NULL END) AS sales_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = '2020' THEN amount_sold ELSE NULL END) AS sales_2020
    FROM filtered_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, sales_month
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id, 
        sales_month,
        ((sales_2020 - sales_2019) * 1.0 / NULLIF(sales_2019, 0)) * sales_2020 + sales_2020 AS proj_2021
    FROM pivoted_sales
    WHERE sales_2019 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2019 != 0 AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL
),
proj_2021_with_currency AS (
    SELECT
        p.sales_month,
        p.proj_2021,
        cu.to_us
    FROM projected_2021 p
    LEFT JOIN currency cu
      ON cu.country = 'France'
     AND cu.year = 2021
     AND cu.month = CAST(p.sales_month AS INTEGER)
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        sales_month,
        ROUND(AVG(proj_2021 * COALESCE(to_us,1)), 2) AS avg_proj_2021_usd
    FROM proj_2021_with_currency
    GROUP BY sales_month
)
SELECT sales_month AS month, avg_proj_2021_usd
FROM agg
ORDER BY month;

WITH italian_customers AS (
  SELECT c.cust_id
  FROM customers c
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
),
dec_sales AS (
  SELECT s.cust_id, s.prod_id, s.quantity_sold, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
  FROM sales s
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE t.calendar_month_number = 12 AND t.calendar_year = 2021
),
profit_per_customer AS (
  SELECT ic.cust_id, SUM(ds.quantity_sold * (p.prod_list_price - p.prod_min_price)) AS total_profit
  FROM italian_customers ic
  JOIN dec_sales ds ON ic.cust_id = ds.cust_id
  JOIN products p ON ds.prod_id = p.prod_id
  GROUP BY ic.cust_id
),
profit_range AS (
  SELECT MIN(total_profit) AS min_profit, MAX(total_profit) AS max_profit FROM profit_per_customer
),
profits_with_bucket AS (
  SELECT
    ppc.total_profit,
    ppc.cust_id,
    pr.min_profit,
    pr.max_profit,
    (CASE WHEN pr.max_profit = pr.min_profit THEN 1
          ELSE CAST(1 + (ppc.total_profit - pr.min_profit) * 10.0 / (pr.max_profit - pr.min_profit) AS INTEGER) END) AS bucket
  FROM profit_per_customer ppc, profit_range pr
)
SELECT
  bucket,
  COUNT(cust_id) AS num_customers,
  MIN(total_profit) AS min_profit_in_bucket,
  MAX(total_profit) AS max_profit_in_bucket
FROM profits_with_bucket
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

WITH us_products AS (
  SELECT s.product_id, s.city, s.calendar_quarter_id, s.sales_amount
  FROM sales s
  JOIN countries c ON s.country_id = c.country_id
  WHERE c.country_name = 'United States' AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND s.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
),
sales_by_city_quarter AS (
  SELECT city, calendar_quarter_id, SUM(sales_amount) AS total_sales
  FROM us_products
  GROUP BY city, calendar_quarter_id
),
city_growth AS (
  SELECT
    q19.city,
    q19.total_sales AS sales_2019,
    q20.total_sales AS sales_2020,
    (CAST(q20.total_sales AS FLOAT) - q19.total_sales) / q19.total_sales AS growth_rate
  FROM
    (SELECT * FROM sales_by_city_quarter WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1772) q19
    JOIN (SELECT * FROM sales_by_city_quarter WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1776) q20
      ON q19.city = q20.city
  WHERE q19.total_sales > 0
),
qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT city
  FROM city_growth
  WHERE growth_rate >= 0.2
),
filtered_sales AS (
  SELECT s.product_id, s.calendar_quarter_id, s.sales_amount
  FROM us_products s
  WHERE s.city IN (SELECT city FROM qualifying_cities)
),
product_total_sales AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(sales_amount) AS total_sales
  FROM filtered_sales
  GROUP BY product_id
),
top_20pct_threshold AS (
  SELECT
    PERCENTILE_DISC(0.8) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_sales) AS threshold
  FROM product_total_sales
),
top_products AS (
  SELECT product_id, total_sales
  FROM product_total_sales, top_20pct_threshold
  WHERE total_sales >= threshold
),
product_sales_share AS (
  SELECT
    f.product_id,
    f.calendar_quarter_id,
    SUM(f.sales_amount) AS product_sales,
    ts.total_sales AS total_quarter_sales
  FROM filtered_sales f
  JOIN (
    SELECT calendar_quarter_id, SUM(sales_amount) AS total_sales
    FROM filtered_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
  ) ts
    ON f.calendar_quarter_id = ts.calendar_quarter_id
  WHERE f.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM top_products)
  GROUP BY f.product_id, f.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_sales_share_change AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    (p2020.product_sales * 1.0 / p2020.total_quarter_sales) - (p2019.product_sales * 1.0 / p2019.total_quarter_sales) AS pct_point_change
  FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM top_products) p
    JOIN product_sales_share p2019 ON p.product_id = p2019.product_id AND p2019.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
    JOIN product_sales_share p2020 ON p.product_id = p2020.product_id AND p2020.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
)
SELECT p.product_id
FROM product_sales_share_change p
ORDER BY ABS(p.pct_point_change) ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH monthly_balance AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', transaction_date) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'deposit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'withdrawal' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance
  FROM bitcoin_transactions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', transaction_date) = '2020'
  GROUP BY customer_id, month
),
positive_balance_counts AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS positive_customer_count
  FROM monthly_balance
  WHERE month_end_balance > 0
  GROUP BY month
),
extreme_months AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT month FROM positive_balance_counts ORDER BY positive_customer_count DESC, month ASC LIMIT 1) AS max_month,
    (SELECT month FROM positive_balance_counts ORDER BY positive_customer_count ASC, month ASC LIMIT 1) AS min_month
),
avg_balance_per_extreme_month AS (
  SELECT
    mb.month,
    AVG(mb.month_end_balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM monthly_balance mb
  JOIN extreme_months em
    ON mb.month = em.max_month OR mb.month = em.min_month
  GROUP BY mb.month
)
SELECT
  em.max_month AS month_with_most_positive_balances,
  em.min_month AS month_with_least_positive_balances,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ab.month = em.max_month THEN ab.avg_balance END) AS avg_balance_max_month,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ab.month = em.min_month THEN ab.avg_balance END) AS avg_balance_min_month,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ab.month = em.max_month THEN ab.avg_balance END) - 
    MAX(CASE WHEN ab.month = em.min_month THEN ab.avg_balance END) AS avg_balance_difference
FROM extreme_months em
JOIN avg_balance_per_extreme_month ab
  ON ab.month = em.max_month OR ab.month = em.min_month
;

WITH filtered_orders AS (

  JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders r ON o.order_id = r.order_id

),
base_prices AS (

),
extra_toppings AS (

)
SELECT SUM(b.base_price + COALESCE(e.extra_count, 0)) AS total_income

WITH delivered_orders AS (

),
recipe_toppings AS (

  JOIN (

)
SELECT topping_name AS ingredient, COUNT(*) AS total_quantity

WITH italian_dec2021_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        SUM(s.profit) AS total_profit
    FROM
        customers c
        JOIN sales s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id

    WHERE

    GROUP BY
        c.customer_id, c.customer_name
),
tiered_profits AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        customer_name,
        total_profit,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) AS profit_tier
    FROM italian_dec2021_sales
)
SELECT
    profit_tier,

WITH city_inserts AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y', created_at) AS year,
        strftime('%m', created_at) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS monthly_total
    FROM cities
    WHERE (strftime('%m', created_at) IN ('04','05','06'))
      AND (strftime('%Y', created_at) IN ('2021','2022','2023'))
    GROUP BY year, month
),
months AS (
    SELECT '04' AS month UNION ALL
    SELECT '05' UNION ALL
    SELECT '06'
),
years AS (
    SELECT '2021' AS year UNION ALL
    SELECT '2022' UNION ALL
    SELECT '2023'
),
base_grid AS (
    SELECT y.year, m.month
    FROM years y
    CROSS JOIN months m
),
city_counts AS (
    SELECT
        g.year,
        g.month,
        COALESCE(ci.monthly_total, 0) AS monthly_total
    FROM base_grid g
    LEFT JOIN city_inserts ci
        ON g.year = ci.year AND g.month = ci.month
),
running_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c1.year,
        c1.month,
        c1.monthly_total,
        SUM(c2.monthly_total) AS running_total
    FROM city_counts c1
    JOIN city_counts c2
        ON c1.month = c2.month
       AND c2.year <= c1.year
    GROUP BY c1.year, c1.month, c1.monthly_total
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        rt.year,
        rt.month,
        rt.monthly_total,
        rt.running_total,
        LAG(rt.monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY rt.month ORDER BY rt.year) AS prev_monthly_total,
        LAG(rt.running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY rt.month ORDER BY rt.year) AS prev_running_total
    FROM running_totals rt
    WHERE rt.year IN ('2021','2022','2023')
),
final_growth AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        month,
        monthly_total,
        running_total,
        CASE
            WHEN prev_monthly_total IS NULL OR prev_monthly_total = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (monthly_total - prev_monthly_total) / prev_monthly_total, 2)
        END AS yoy_monthly_growth_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN prev_running_total IS NULL OR prev_running_total = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (running_total - prev_running_total) / prev_running_total, 2)
        END AS yoy_running_growth_pct
    FROM final
)
SELECT
    year,
    month,
    monthly_total,
    running_total,
    yoy_monthly_growth_pct,
    yoy_running_growth_pct
FROM final_growth
WHERE year IN ('2022', '2023')
ORDER BY month, year

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        city_id, 
        city_name, 
        insert_date
    FROM cities
    WHERE country_code_2 = 'cn'
      AND insert_date BETWEEN '2021-07-01' AND '2021-07-31'
),
row_nums AS (
    SELECT 
        city_id, 
        city_name, 
        DATE(insert_date) AS insert_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY DATE(insert_date)) AS rn,
        JULIANDAY(DATE(insert_date)) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY DATE(insert_date)) AS grp
    FROM filtered
),
groups AS (
    SELECT 
        grp, 
        MIN(DATE(insert_date)) AS streak_start,
        MAX(DATE(insert_date)) AS streak_end,
        COUNT(*) AS streak_len
    FROM row_nums
    GROUP BY grp
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT streak_start, streak_end, streak_len
    FROM groups
    WHERE streak_len = (SELECT MIN(streak_len) FROM groups)
       OR streak_len = (SELECT MAX(streak_len) FROM groups)
),
streak_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        s.streak_start, s.streak_end, s.streak_len, r.insert_date
    FROM streaks s
    JOIN row_nums r ON r.insert_date BETWEEN s.streak_start AND s.streak_end
),
sample_per_date AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.streak_start, sd.streak_end, sd.streak_len, sd.insert_date,
        (SELECT city_name FROM filtered f WHERE DATE(f.insert_date) = sd.insert_date LIMIT 1) AS city_name
    FROM streak_dates sd
)
SELECT 
    streak_start, streak_end, streak_len,
    insert_date,
    UPPER(SUBSTR(city_name,1,1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(city_name,2)) AS city_name
FROM sample_per_date
ORDER BY streak_len, insert_date;

WITH june_cities AS (
  SELECT
    c.id AS city_id,
    cc.country_code,
    date(c.inserted_at) AS insert_date
  FROM cities c
  JOIN cities_countries cc ON c.id = cc.city_id
  WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', c.inserted_at) = '2022-06'
),
ranked_cities AS (
  SELECT
    country_code,
    insert_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY country_code ORDER BY insert_date
    ) AS rn1,
    JULIANDAY(insert_date) -
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY country_code ORDER BY insert_date
      ) AS grp
  FROM june_cities
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT
    country_code,
    COUNT(*) AS streak_length
  FROM ranked_cities
  GROUP BY country_code, grp
),
max_streaks AS (
  SELECT
    country_code,
    MAX(streak_length) AS max_streak
  FROM streaks
  GROUP BY country_code
),
top_streak AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(max_streak) AS top_length
  FROM max_streaks
)
SELECT
  ms.country_code
FROM max_streaks ms, top_streak ts
WHERE ms.max_streak = ts.top_length;

WITH jan_entries AS (
  SELECT
    ad.id,
    ad.city_id,
    c.country,
    DATE(ad.created_at) as entry_date
  FROM alien_data ad
  JOIN cities c ON ad.city_id = c.id
  WHERE ad.created_at BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-01-31'
),
country_9days AS (
  SELECT
    country
  FROM jan_entries
  GROUP BY country
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT entry_date) = 9
),
country_entries AS (
  SELECT
    je.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY je.country ORDER BY je.entry_date) AS rn,
    JULIANDAY(je.entry_date) -
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY je.country ORDER BY je.entry_date) AS grp
  FROM jan_entries je
  JOIN country_9days c9 ON je.country = c9.country
  GROUP BY je.country, je.entry_date -- Make sure only unique date per country-row, if multiple entries per day, keep all for later count
),
consecutive_groups AS (
  SELECT
    country,
    grp,
    MIN(entry_date) AS start_date,
    MAX(entry_date) AS end_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT entry_date) AS days_count
  FROM country_entries
  GROUP BY country, grp
),
longest_grp AS (
  SELECT
    country,
    grp,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    days_count
  FROM (
      SELECT *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY days_count DESC, start_date ASC) as rnk
      FROM consecutive_groups
  )
  WHERE rnk = 1
),
country_capital AS (
  SELECT
    c9.country,
    c.id AS capital_city_id
  FROM country_9days c9
  JOIN cities c ON c.country = c9.country AND c.is_capital = 1
),
final_period_entries AS (
  SELECT
    ce.country,
    ce.entry_date,
    ce.city_id
  FROM country_entries ce
  JOIN longest_grp lg ON ce.country = lg.country
  WHERE ce.entry_date BETWEEN lg.start_date AND lg.end_date
),
total_and_capital_counts AS (
  SELECT
    fpe.country,
    COUNT(*) AS total_entries,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fpe.city_id = cc.capital_city_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS capital_entries
  FROM final_period_entries fpe
  JOIN country_capital cc ON fpe.country = cc.country
  GROUP BY fpe.country
)
SELECT
  tcc.country,
  tcc.total_entries,
  tcc.capital_entries,
  CAST(tcc.capital_entries AS FLOAT) / tcc.total_entries AS proportion_from_capital
FROM total_and_capital_counts tcc
;

WITH base_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.pizza_id,
        o.customer_id,
        n.pizza_name,
        o.exclusions,
        o.extras,
        o.order_time,
        CASE 
            WHEN n.pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END AS assigned_pizza_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders o
    JOIN pizza_names n ON o.pizza_id = n.pizza_id
),
recipe_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        r.pizza_id,
        t.topping_id,
        t.topping_name
    FROM pizza_recipes r
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON ',' || r.toppings || ',' LIKE '%,' || t.topping_id || ',%'
),
order_exclusions AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        t.topping_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders o
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON ',' || ifnull(o.exclusions, '') || ',' LIKE '%,' || t.topping_id || ',%'
),
order_extras AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        t.topping_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders o
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON ',' || ifnull(o.extras, '') || ',' LIKE '%,' || t.topping_id || ',%'
),
order_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 
        bo.order_id,
        bo.customer_id,
        bo.pizza_name,
        bo.order_time,
        rt.topping_name,
        1 as source
    FROM base_orders bo
    LEFT JOIN recipe_toppings rt ON (bo.assigned_pizza_id = rt.pizza_id)
    WHERE rt.topping_name IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        bo.order_id,
        bo.customer_id,
        bo.pizza_name,
        bo.order_time,
        t.topping_name,
        -1 as source
    FROM base_orders bo
    JOIN order_exclusions oe ON bo.order_id = oe.order_id
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON oe.topping_id = t.topping_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        bo.order_id,
        bo.customer_id,
        bo.pizza_name,
        bo.order_time,
        t.topping_name,
        2 as source
    FROM base_orders bo
    JOIN order_extras oe ON bo.order_id = oe.order_id
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON oe.topping_id = t.topping_id
),
agg_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_name,
        order_time,
        topping_name,
        SUM(source) as net_count
    FROM order_ingredients
    GROUP BY order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping_name
    HAVING SUM(source) > 0
),
exploded AS (
    SELECT 
        ai.order_id,
        ai.customer_id,
        ai.pizza_name,
        ai.order_time,
        CASE WHEN ai.net_count > 1 THEN '2x' || ai.topping_name ELSE ai.topping_name END as ingr,
        ai.net_count
    FROM agg_ingredients ai
),
sorted_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 
        e.order_id,
        e.customer_id,
        e.pizza_name,
        e.order_time,
        GROUP_CONCAT(e.ingr, ', ') as ingredient_set
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            *,
            CASE WHEN net_count > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as sort_group
        FROM exploded
        ORDER BY order_id, sort_group, ingr
    ) e
    GROUP BY e.order_id, e.customer_id, e.pizza_name, e.order_time
)
SELECT 
    si.order_id, 
    si.customer_id,
    si.pizza_name,
    (si.pizza_name || ': ' || ifnull(si.ingredient_set, '')) AS final_ingredients
FROM sorted_ingredients si
ORDER BY si.order_id ASC;

WITH months AS (
    SELECT 
        DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS year_month
    FROM customer_transactions
    ORDER BY year_month
),
customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_months AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        m.year_month
    FROM customers c
    CROSS JOIN months m
),
txns_with_month AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        date,
        amount,
        strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS year_month
    FROM customer_transactions
),
monthly_txn_summary AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        year_month,
        SUM(amount) AS monthly_change
    FROM txns_with_month
    GROUP BY customer_id, year_month
),
all_customer_months AS (
    SELECT
        cm.customer_id,
        cm.year_month,
        COALESCE(mts.monthly_change, 0) AS monthly_change
    FROM customer_months cm
    LEFT JOIN monthly_txn_summary mts
        ON cm.customer_id = mts.customer_id
        AND cm.year_month = mts.year_month
),
cumulative_balance AS (
    SELECT
        acm.customer_id,
        acm.year_month,
        acm.monthly_change,
        SUM(acm.monthly_change) OVER (
            PARTITION BY acm.customer_id
            ORDER BY acm.year_month
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cumulative_balance
    FROM all_customer_months acm
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    year_month,
    monthly_change,
    cumulative_balance AS closing_balance
FROM cumulative_balance
ORDER BY customer_id, year_month;

WITH filtered_events AS (
  SELECT
    sce.product_id,
    sce.event_type,
    sce.page_id,
    sce.cart_id
  FROM shopping_cart_events sce
  WHERE sce.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
event_counts AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS add_to_cart_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'purchase' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_count
  FROM filtered_events
  GROUP BY product_id
),
abandoned_carts AS (
  -- products in cart without a purchase event for the cart
  SELECT
    e.product_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.cart_id) AS abandoned_count
  FROM filtered_events e
  WHERE e.event_type = 'add_to_cart'
    AND e.cart_id NOT IN (

      FROM filtered_events
      WHERE event_type = 'purchase'
    )
  GROUP BY e.product_id
)
SELECT
  ec.product_id,
  ec.view_count,
  ec.add_to_cart_count,
  COALESCE(a.abandoned_count, 0) AS abandoned_cart_count,

ORDER BY ec.product_id;

WITH monthly_interest_composition AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month,
    interest,
    AVG(CAST(composition AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(index_value,0)) AS avg_composition_index
  FROM interest_metrics
  WHERE date >= '2018-09-01' AND date < '2019-09-01'
  GROUP BY month, interest
),
monthly_max_interest AS (
  SELECT
    a.month,
    a.interest,
    a.avg_composition_index AS max_index_composition
  FROM monthly_interest_composition a
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      month,
      MAX(avg_composition_index) AS max_comp
    FROM monthly_interest_composition
    GROUP BY month
  ) b
    ON a.month = b.month AND a.avg_composition_index = b.max_comp
),
enriched_max_interest AS (
  SELECT
    m1.month,
    m1.interest,
    m1.max_index_composition,
    -- Lag: previous month
    LAG(m1.interest, 1) OVER (ORDER BY m1.month) AS prev_interest_1,
    LAG(m1.max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY m1.month) AS prev_max_index_comp_1,
    -- Lag: 2 months ago
    LAG(m1.interest, 2) OVER (ORDER BY m1.month) AS prev_interest_2,
    LAG(m1.max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY m1.month) AS prev_max_index_comp_2,
    -- Rolling 3-month average
    ROUND(AVG(m1.max_index_composition) OVER (ORDER BY m1.month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 6) AS rolling_avg_3m
  FROM monthly_max_interest m1
)
SELECT
  month AS date,
  interest,
  max_index_composition,
  rolling_avg_3m AS rolling_avg_max_index_composition_3m,
  prev_interest_1 AS prev_month_interest,
  prev_max_index_comp_1 AS prev_month_max_index_composition,
  prev_interest_2 AS prev2_month_interest,
  prev_max_index_comp_2 AS prev2_month_max_index_composition
FROM enriched_max_interest
ORDER BY month;

WITH ranked_interest AS (

        strftime('%m-%Y', time) AS month_year,
        interest_name,
        composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY interest_name ORDER BY composition DESC) AS rn

)
SELECT
    month_year,

ORDER BY composition DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT

),
grouped_customers AS (
  SELECT
    cs.customer_id,
    cs.total_spent,
    cgt.group_name
  FROM
    customer_spending cs
    LEFT JOIN customergroupthreshold cgt
      ON cs.total_spent >= cgt.min_spend AND (cs.total_spent < cgt.max_spend OR cgt.max_spend IS NULL)
)
SELECT
  gc.group_name,
  COUNT(*) AS num_customers,

WITH emp_orders AS (

),
emp_late_pct AS (

WITH movie_years AS (

all_cast_genders AS (

exclusive_female_movies AS (

period_counts AS (

  WHERE m.release_date IS NOT NULL

WITH actor_years AS (
  SELECT
    M_Cast.person_id,
    strftime('%Y', Movie.release_date) AS year
  FROM M_Cast
  JOIN Movie ON M_Cast.movie_id = Movie.id
  WHERE Movie.release_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY M_Cast.person_id, year
),
actor_minmax AS (
  SELECT
    person_id,
    MIN(CAST(year AS INTEGER)) AS first_year,
    MAX(CAST(year AS INTEGER)) AS last_year
  FROM actor_years
  GROUP BY person_id
),
actor_missing_gaps AS (
  SELECT
    a.person_id,
    COUNT(1) AS max_consec_gap
  FROM actor_minmax a
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      ay.person_id,
      y AS chk_year
    FROM actor_minmax am
    JOIN generate_series(am.first_year, am.last_year, 1) AS y
      ON 1=1
    LEFT JOIN actor_years ay
      ON ay.person_id = am.person_id AND ay.year = CAST(y AS TEXT)
    WHERE ay.year IS NULL
  ) AS gaps
    ON a.person_id = gaps.person_id
  GROUP BY a.person_id
),
actor_gaps AS (
  SELECT
    a.person_id,
    a.first_year,
    a.last_year,
    -- Build a list of years and spot max consecutive gap between appearances
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(gap_len) 
      FROM (
        SELECT
          LEAD(year) OVER (ORDER BY year) - year AS gap_len
        FROM (
          SELECT
            CAST(year AS INTEGER) AS year
          FROM actor_years
          WHERE person_id = a.person_id
          UNION ALL
          SELECT a.first_year - 1
          UNION ALL
          SELECT a.last_year + 1
        )
        ORDER BY year
      ) WHERE gap_len IS NOT NULL
    ) AS max_gap
  FROM actor_minmax a
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM actor_gaps
WHERE max_gap <= 4

WITH actor_director_films AS (

        M_Director.person_id AS director_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT M_Cast.movie_id) AS film_count
    FROM

),
yash_chopra_id AS (

),
actor_max_by_director AS (

actor_yash_films AS (

        AND (

)
;

WITH shahrukh AS (

shahrukh_movies AS (

first_degree AS (

first_degree_movies AS (

second_degree AS (

WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT
        wr.region_id,
        wr.region_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wo.order_id) AS num_orders,
        SUM(wo.sales_amount) AS total_sales_amount
    FROM web_orders wo
    JOIN web_region wr ON wo.region_id = wr.region_id
    GROUP BY wr.region_id, wr.region_name
),
rep_sales AS (
    SELECT
        wr.region_id,
        ws.sales_rep_id,
        ws.rep_name,
        SUM(wo.sales_amount) AS rep_total_sales_amount
    FROM web_orders wo
    JOIN web_sales_reps ws ON wo.sales_rep_id = ws.sales_rep_id
    JOIN web_region wr ON wo.region_id = wr.region_id
    GROUP BY wr.region_id, ws.sales_rep_id, ws.rep_name
),
region_max AS (
    SELECT
        region_id,
        MAX(rep_total_sales_amount) AS max_rep_sales_amount
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_id
),
top_reps AS (
    SELECT
        rs.region_id,
        rs.rep_name,
        rs.rep_total_sales_amount
    FROM rep_sales rs
    JOIN region_max rm ON rs.region_id = rm.region_id AND rs.rep_total_sales_amount = rm.max_rep_sales_amount
)
SELECT
    reg.region_name,
    reg.num_orders,
    reg.total_sales_amount,
    tr.rep_name AS top_sales_rep_name,
    tr.rep_total_sales_amount AS top_sales_rep_amount
FROM region_sales reg
LEFT JOIN top_reps tr ON reg.region_id = tr.region_id
ORDER BY reg.region_name, tr.rep_name;

WITH WinningGames AS (

        b.FirstName,
        b.LastName,

    FROM Bowler_Scores bs

    JOIN Match_Games mg ON bs.MatchID = mg.MatchID AND bs.GameNo = mg.GameNo
    JOIN Tournaments t ON mg.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
    WHERE bs.WonInd = 1
      AND bs.HandiScore <= 190
      AND t.Location IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
),
QualifiedBowlers AS (
    SELECT 
        BowlerID
    FROM WinningGames
    GROUP BY BowlerID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Location) = 3
)
SELECT 
    wg.BowlerID,
    wg.FirstName,
    wg.LastName,
    wg.MatchNo,
    wg.GameNo,
    wg.HandiScore,
    wg.TourneyDate,
    wg.Location
FROM WinningGames wg
JOIN QualifiedBowlers qb ON wg.BowlerID = qb.BowlerID
ORDER BY wg.BowlerID, wg.TourneyDate, wg.MatchNo, wg.GameNo;

WITH EnglishCourses AS (
  SELECT s.StudentID, s.LastName, scs.Grade
  FROM Students s
  JOIN Student_Class_Status scs ON s.StudentID = scs.StudentID
  JOIN Classes c ON scs.ClassID = c.ClassID
  JOIN Subjects subj ON c.SubjectID = subj.SubjectID
  WHERE scs.ClassStatus = 2
    AND subj.SubjectName = 'English'
),
Ranked AS (
  SELECT
    StudentID,
    LastName,
    Grade,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Grade) 
      FROM EnglishCourses ec2 
      WHERE ec2.Grade >= ec1.Grade
    ) AS RankDesc
  FROM EnglishCourses ec1
),
StudentCount AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_students FROM EnglishCourses
),
WithQuintile AS (
  SELECT 
    r.LastName,
    r.Grade,
    r.RankDesc,
    sc.total_students,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(r.RankDesc AS FLOAT) / sc.total_students <= 0.2 THEN 'First'
      WHEN CAST(r.RankDesc AS FLOAT) / sc.total_students <= 0.4 THEN 'Second'
      WHEN CAST(r.RankDesc AS FLOAT) / sc.total_students <= 0.6 THEN 'Third'
      WHEN CAST(r.RankDesc AS FLOAT) / sc.total_students <= 0.8 THEN 'Fourth'
      ELSE 'Fifth'
    END AS Quintile
  FROM Ranked r
  CROSS JOIN StudentCount sc
)
SELECT LastName, Quintile
FROM WithQuintile
ORDER BY
  CASE Quintile
    WHEN 'First' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Second' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Third' THEN 3
    WHEN 'Fourth' THEN 4
    WHEN 'Fifth' THEN 5
    ELSE 6
  END,
  LastName
;

SELECT
  ms.Musical_Style,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mp.Preference_Order = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS First_Preference_Count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mp.Preference_Order = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Second_Preference_Count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mp.Preference_Order = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Third_Preference_Count
FROM
  Musical_Styles ms
LEFT JOIN
  Musical_Preferences mp
  ON ms.ID = mp.Musical_Style_ID
GROUP BY
  ms.Musical_Style;

WITH Entertainer_Style_Rank AS (
    SELECT 
        Entertainer_Id, 
        Style_Id, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Entertainer_Id ORDER BY id) AS Style_Rank
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
),
Entertainer_Style_Agg AS (
    SELECT 
        Entertainer_Id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_styles,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Style_Rank = 1 THEN Style_Id END) AS Style1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Style_Rank = 2 THEN Style_Id END) AS Style2
    FROM Entertainer_Style_Rank
    GROUP BY Entertainer_Id
    HAVING num_styles <= 3
),
Customer_Pref_Rank AS (
    SELECT 
        Customer_Id, 
        Style_Id, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Customer_Id ORDER BY id) AS Pref_Rank
    FROM Musical_Preferences
),
Customer_Pref_Agg AS (
    SELECT 
        Customer_Id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_prefs,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Pref_Rank = 1 THEN Style_Id END) AS Pref1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Pref_Rank = 2 THEN Style_Id END) AS Pref2
    FROM Customer_Pref_Rank
    GROUP BY Customer_Id
    HAVING num_prefs <= 3
)
SELECT e.Stage_Name, c.Last_Name
FROM Entertainer_Style_Agg esa
JOIN Entertainers e ON esa.Entertainer_Id = e.Id
JOIN Customer_Pref_Agg cpa
    ON (
        -- Match first and second in order
        (esa.Style1 = cpa.Pref1 AND esa.Style2 = cpa.Pref2)
        -- Or match first and second in reverse order
        OR (esa.Style1 = cpa.Pref2 AND esa.Style2 = cpa.Pref1)
    )
JOIN Customers c ON cpa.Customer_Id = c.Id;

WITH WeightedScores AS (
  SELECT
    Musical_Style_ID,
    SUM(
      CASE PreferenceSeq
        WHEN 1 THEN 3
        WHEN 2 THEN 2
        WHEN 3 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS total_weighted_score
  FROM Musical_Preferences
  WHERE PreferenceSeq IN (1,2,3)
  GROUP BY Musical_Style_ID
),
AverageScore AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_weighted_score) AS avg_weighted_score
  FROM WeightedScores
)
SELECT
  ms.Musical_Style_ID,
  ms.StyleName,
  ws.total_weighted_score,
  ROUND(ABS(ws.total_weighted_score - a.avg_weighted_score),2) AS abs_diff_from_avg
FROM WeightedScores ws
JOIN Musical_Styles ms ON ws.Musical_Style_ID = ms.Musical_Style_ID
CROSS JOIN AverageScore a
ORDER BY abs_diff_from_avg DESC, ms.Musical_Style_ID;

WITH annual_sales AS (
  SELECT
    soh.SalesPersonID,
    strftime('%Y', soh.OrderDate) AS SalesYear,
    SUM(sod.LineTotal) AS TotalSales
  FROM salesorderheader soh
  JOIN salesorderdetail sod ON soh.SalesOrderID = sod.SalesOrderID
  WHERE soh.SalesPersonID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY soh.SalesPersonID, SalesYear
),
annual_quota AS (
  SELECT
    SalesPersonID,
    strftime('%Y', QuotaDate) AS QuotaYear,
    SUM(SalesQuota) AS AnnualQuota
  FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
  GROUP BY SalesPersonID, QuotaYear
)
SELECT
  a.SalesPersonID,
  a.SalesYear AS Year,
  a.TotalSales,
  q.AnnualQuota,
  (a.TotalSales - COALESCE(q.AnnualQuota, 0)) AS SalesMinusQuota
FROM annual_sales a
LEFT JOIN annual_quota q
  ON a.SalesPersonID = q.SalesPersonID AND a.SalesYear = q.QuotaYear
ORDER BY a.SalesPersonID, a.SalesYear;

WITH director_movies AS (
  SELECT
    dm.director_id,
    n.primary_name AS director_name,
    m.id AS movie_id,
    m.runtime_minutes,
    r.average_rating,
    r.num_votes,
    m.start_year
  FROM director_mapping dm
  JOIN names n ON dm.director_id = n.id
  JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
  LEFT JOIN ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
),
movie_counts AS (
  SELECT
    director_id,
    director_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_movies,
    SUM(runtime_minutes) AS total_movie_duration
  FROM director_movies
  GROUP BY director_id, director_name
),
inter_movie_duration AS (
  SELECT
    director_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN
        ROUND(AVG(diff))
      ELSE NULL
    END AS avg_inter_movie_duration
  FROM (
    SELECT
      director_id,
      start_year,
      start_year - LAG(start_year) OVER (PARTITION BY director_id ORDER BY start_year) AS diff
    FROM director_movies
    WHERE start_year IS NOT NULL
  )
  GROUP BY director_id
),
director_stats AS (
  SELECT
    dm.director_id,
    dm.director_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_movies,
    ROUND(AVG(dm.runtime_minutes)) AS avg_movie_duration,
    ROUND(AVG(dm.average_rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
    SUM(dm.num_votes) AS total_votes,
    MIN(dm.average_rating) AS min_rating,

  FROM director_movies dm

)
SELECT

  ds.num_movies,
  imd.avg_inter_movie_duration,
  ds.avg_rating,
  ds.total_votes,

FROM director_stats ds

WITH purchase_data AS (
    SELECT
        r.region_id,
        strftime('%Y', t.date) AS year,
        SUM(t.price_usd * t.quantity_btc) AS total_spent_usd,
        SUM(t.quantity_btc) AS total_btc_purchased
    FROM customer_transactions t
    JOIN customer_nodes n ON t.customer_id = n.customer_id
    JOIN customer_regions r ON n.region_id = r.region_id
    WHERE t.type = 'buy'
    GROUP BY r.region_id, year
),
first_years AS (
    SELECT
        region_id,
        MIN(year) AS first_year
    FROM purchase_data
    GROUP BY region_id
),
filtered_data AS (
    SELECT
        pd.region_id,
        pd.year,
        pd.total_spent_usd,
        pd.total_btc_purchased,
        pd.total_spent_usd * 1.0 / pd.total_btc_purchased AS avg_purchase_price
    FROM purchase_data pd
    JOIN first_years fy ON pd.region_id = fy.region_id
    WHERE pd.year > fy.first_year
),
region_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY avg_purchase_price DESC) AS region_rank
    FROM filtered_data
),
annual_change AS (
    SELECT
        rd.region_id,
        rd.year,
        rd.avg_purchase_price,
        rd.region_rank,
        (rd.avg_purchase_price - lag(rd.avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.region_id ORDER BY rd.year))
            / lag(rd.avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.region_id ORDER BY rd.year)
            AS pct_change_vs_prev_year
    FROM region_ranked rd
)
SELECT 
    r.region_id,
    r.year,
    r.avg_purchase_price,
    r.region_rank,
    r.pct_change_vs_prev_year
FROM annual_change r
ORDER BY r.year, r.region_rank

WITH parsed_volumes AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    ticker,
    CASE
      WHEN TRIM(volume) = '-' THEN 0
      WHEN TRIM(volume) LIKE '%M' THEN
        CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(volume), 'M', ''), ',', '') AS FLOAT) * 1000000
      WHEN TRIM(volume) LIKE '%K' THEN
        CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(volume), 'K', ''), ',', '') AS FLOAT) * 1000
      ELSE
        CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(volume), ',', ''), ' ', '') AS FLOAT)
    END AS volume_value
  FROM bitcoin_prices
  WHERE date BETWEEN '2021-08-01' AND '2021-08-10'
),
volumes_with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    pv1.date,
    pv1.ticker,
    pv1.volume_value,
    (
      SELECT pv2.volume_value
      FROM parsed_volumes pv2
      WHERE pv2.ticker = pv1.ticker
        AND pv2.date < pv1.date
        AND pv2.volume_value > 0
      ORDER BY pv2.date DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS prev_non_zero_volume
  FROM parsed_volumes pv1
)
SELECT
  date,
  ticker,
  volume_value AS volume,
  prev_non_zero_volume,
  CASE
    WHEN prev_non_zero_volume IS NOT NULL AND prev_non_zero_volume != 0
      THEN ROUND( (volume_value - prev_non_zero_volume) / prev_non_zero_volume * 100, 4)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS pct_change
FROM volumes_with_prev
ORDER BY ticker, date;

WITH 
-- Get each legislator's first term start date and filter for the cohort
cohort AS (
  SELECT
    l.id AS legislator_id,
    MIN(lt.start_date) AS first_term_start
  FROM legislators l
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id = lt.legislator_id
  WHERE DATE(lt.start_date) BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'
  GROUP BY l.id
),

-- For each legislator in cohort, get max office end date across all terms
cohort_with_end AS (
  SELECT
    c.legislator_id,
    c.first_term_start,
    MAX(lt.end_date) AS last_term_end
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON c.legislator_id = lt.legislator_id
  GROUP BY c.legislator_id, c.first_term_start
),

-- Build all 20 retention 'years' (0 to 19) for each legislator
all_years AS (
  SELECT
    cwe.legislator_id,
    cwe.first_term_start,
    cwe.last_term_end,
    y.year_idx,
    DATE(cwe.first_term_start, printf('+%d years','0')) AS year0,
    DATE(cwe.first_term_start, printf('+%d years', y.year_idx)) AS cohort_year_date
  FROM cohort_with_end cwe
  JOIN (SELECT 0 as year_idx UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL
              SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL
              SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL
              SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19) y
),

-- Determine, for each legislator and year, if in office on Dec 31 of that year
retention_flags AS (
  SELECT
    ay.year_idx,
    ay.cohort_year_date,
    ay.legislator_id,
    ay.first_term_start,
    ay.last_term_end,
    -- Find the Dec 31 date for the Nth cohort year
    DATE(STRFTIME('%Y', ay.cohort_year_date) || '-12-31') AS year_end_date,
    -- Retained if last_term_end is null or after this year_end_date
    CASE
      WHEN (ay.last_term_end IS NULL OR DATE(ay.last_term_end) >= DATE(STRFTIME('%Y', ay.cohort_year_date) || '-12-31'))
           AND DATE(ay.first_term_start) <= DATE(STRFTIME('%Y', ay.cohort_year_date) || '-12-31')
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained
  FROM all_years ay
),

-- Compute denominators (cohort size)
cohort_size AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT legislator_id) AS n_cohort FROM cohort
)

SELECT
  rf.year_idx + 1 AS year_number,
  rf.year_end_date,
  ROUND(1.0 * SUM(rf.retained) / cs.n_cohort, 4) AS retention_rate
FROM retention_flags rf
CROSS JOIN cohort_size cs
GROUP BY rf.year_idx, rf.year_end_date
ORDER BY rf.year_idx
LIMIT 20;

WITH intervals AS (
  SELECT 0 as interval_years UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 UNION ALL
  SELECT 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT 10
),
first_terms AS (
  -- For each legislator, find their first term's start date and the state
  SELECT
    lt.legislator_id,
    MIN(lt.start_date) AS first_start_date,
    lt.state,
    l.gender
  FROM legislators_terms lt
  JOIN legislators l ON lt.legislator_id = l.id
  GROUP BY lt.legislator_id
),
retention_points AS (
  -- Build a row for each interval and legislator with snapshot dates
  SELECT
    ft.legislator_id,
    ft.state,
    ft.gender,
    i.interval_years,
    date(ft.first_start_date, printf('+%d years', i.interval_years)) as snapshot_date
  FROM first_terms ft
  CROSS JOIN intervals i
),
active_at_snapshot AS (
  -- Check if the legislator was serving on that snapshot date
  SELECT
    rp.legislator_id,
    rp.state,
    rp.gender,
    rp.interval_years,
    CASE 
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
        WHERE lt.legislator_id = rp.legislator_id
          AND lt.start_date <= rp.snapshot_date
          AND (lt.end_date IS NULL OR lt.end_date >= rp.snapshot_date)
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END as retained
  FROM retention_points rp
),
retention_rates AS (
  -- For each state/gender/interval, get denominator and number retained
  SELECT
    aa.state,
    aa.gender,
    aa.interval_years,
    COUNT(DISTINCT aa.legislator_id) AS total,
    SUM(aa.retained) AS retained_count,
    1.0 * SUM(aa.retained) / COUNT(DISTINCT aa.legislator_id) AS retention_rate
  FROM active_at_snapshot aa
  GROUP BY aa.state, aa.gender, aa.interval_years
),
retention_check AS (
  -- For each state/gender, require retention_rate > 0 at all 6 intervals
  SELECT
    state,
    gender
  FROM retention_rates
  WHERE retention_rate > 0
  GROUP BY state, gender
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT interval_years) = 6
),
both_genders AS (
  -- Only the states with both genders passing the filter
  SELECT
    state
  FROM retention_check
  GROUP BY state
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gender) = 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT state
FROM both_genders
ORDER BY state;

WITH male_la_legislators AS (

),
years_elapsed AS (
    SELECT
        mll.id,
        mll.first_term_start,

        y.year,

    JOIN (
        -- every possible year to check

),
active_terms AS (

    FROM years_elapsed ye
    JOIN legislators_terms t

     AND DATE(t.start_date) <= DATE(ye.year || '-12-31')
     AND (t.end_date IS NULL OR DATE(t.end_date) >= DATE(ye.year || '-12-31'))
)
SELECT

WITH first_payment AS (

  GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_ltv AS (

    c.customer_id,
    fp.first_payment_date,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_ltv,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%s', p.payment_date) <= strftime('%s', fp.first_payment_date) + 604800 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS ltv_7d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%s', p.payment_date) <= strftime('%s', fp.first_payment_date) + 2592000 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS ltv_30d
  FROM customer c
  JOIN first_payment fp ON c.customer_id = fp.customer_id
  JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, fp.first_payment_date
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN total_ltv > 0 THEN (ltv_7d * 1.0 / total_ltv) ELSE NULL END) * 100, 2) AS avg_pct_ltv_7d,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN total_ltv > 0 THEN (ltv_30d * 1.0 / total_ltv) ELSE NULL END) * 100, 2) AS avg_pct_ltv_30d,
  ROUND(AVG(total_ltv), 2) AS avg_total_ltv
FROM customer_ltv

film_actor_revenue_share AS (

actor_avg_top3_revenue AS (

SELECT

first_rental_per_customer AS (

first_movie_per_customer AS (

customer_total_stats AS (

SELECT

WITH top10_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id
  ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC

),
customer_monthly_payments AS (
  SELECT
    p.customer_id,

    SUM(p.amount) AS monthly_total
  FROM payment p
  WHERE p.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top10_customers)
  GROUP BY p.customer_id, year_month
),
month_over_month_diff AS (
  SELECT
    cmp.customer_id,
    cmp.year_month,
    cmp.monthly_total,
    cmp.monthly_total - LAG(cmp.monthly_total) OVER (
      PARTITION BY cmp.customer_id
      ORDER BY cmp.year_month
    ) AS month_diff,
    LAG(cmp.year_month) OVER (
      PARTITION BY cmp.customer_id
      ORDER BY cmp.year_month
    ) AS prev_year_month
  FROM customer_monthly_payments cmp
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  prev_year_month AS from_month,
  year_month AS to_month,
  ROUND(ABS(month_diff), 2) AS max_monthly_difference

WITH customer_counts AS (

country_sales AS (

eligible_sales AS (

max_rental_per_store AS (

SELECT

WITH filtered_words AS (
  SELECT
    word,
    LENGTH(word) AS len
  FROM word_list
  WHERE LENGTH(word) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
    AND word LIKE 'r%'
),
word_anagram_keys AS (
  SELECT
    word,
    len,
    -- generate an anagram key by sorting characters (case-sensitive)
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(ch, '') FROM (
      SELECT SUBSTR(word, n, 1) AS ch
      FROM (
        WITH RECURSIVE chars(n) AS (
          SELECT 1
          UNION ALL
          SELECT n+1 FROM chars WHERE n < LENGTH(word)
        )
        SELECT n FROM chars
      )
      ORDER BY ch
    )) AS anagram_key
  FROM filtered_words
),
anagram_counts AS (
  SELECT
    w1.word,
    w1.len,
    w1.anagram_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w2.word) AS anagram_count
  FROM word_anagram_keys w1
  JOIN word_anagram_keys w2
    ON w1.anagram_key = w2.anagram_key
    AND w1.len = w2.len
    AND w1.word <> w2.word
  GROUP BY w1.word, w1.len, w1.anagram_key
)
SELECT
  word,
  anagram_count
FROM anagram_counts
ORDER BY word
LIMIT 10;

WITH state_alien_summary AS (
  SELECT
    al.location_state AS state,
    COUNT(a.id) AS alien_population,
    AVG(a.age) AS avg_age,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'friendly' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS friendly_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'hostile' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hostile_count,
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'friendly' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.id) AS pct_friendly,
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'hostile' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.id) AS pct_hostile
  FROM aliens a
  JOIN aliens_location al ON a.id = al.alien_id
  GROUP BY al.location_state
),
top10_states AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM state_alien_summary
  ORDER BY alien_population DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_states
FROM top10_states
WHERE pct_friendly > pct_hostile AND avg_age > 200;

WITH store_order_counts AS (

  FROM

),
top_store AS (

    store_id,

    total_orders
  FROM
    store_order_counts
  ORDER BY

  LIMIT 1
),
delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT

  FROM
    orders o
    JOIN deliveries d ON o.id = d.order_id
  WHERE
    o.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM top_store)
    AND d.status = 'DELIVERED'
)
SELECT
  ts.store_id,
  ts.store_name,
  ts.total_orders,
  COUNT(do.order_id) AS delivered_orders,
  CAST(COUNT(do.order_id) AS FLOAT) / ts.total_orders AS delivered_order_ratio
FROM
  top_store ts
  LEFT JOIN delivered_orders do ON 1=1
GROUP BY
  ts.store_id, ts.store_name, ts.total_orders;

WITH finished_orders_per_month AS (
  SELECT
    hubs.id AS hub_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', orders.created_at) AS order_month,
    COUNT(orders.id) AS finished_orders
  FROM orders
  JOIN hubs ON orders.hub_id = hubs.id
  WHERE orders.status = 'finished'
    AND strftime('%Y-%m', orders.created_at) IN ('2023-02', '2023-03')
  GROUP BY hubs.id, order_month
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    hub_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_month = '2023-02' THEN finished_orders END) AS feb_orders,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_month = '2023-03' THEN finished_orders END) AS mar_orders
  FROM finished_orders_per_month
  GROUP BY hub_id
)
SELECT
  hubs.id,
  hubs.name,
  feb_orders,
  mar_orders,
  ROUND((CAST(mar_orders AS FLOAT) - feb_orders) / feb_orders * 100, 2) AS percent_increase
FROM pivoted
JOIN hubs ON hubs.id = pivoted.hub_id
WHERE
  feb_orders IS NOT NULL
  AND mar_orders IS NOT NULL
  AND (CAST(mar_orders AS FLOAT) - feb_orders) / feb_orders > 0.2
;

WITH daily_deliveries AS (

),
avg_daily_deliveries AS (

SELECT

WITH Team_Season_Goals AS (
  SELECT
    t.team_api_id,
    strftime('%Y', m.date) AS season,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id THEN m.home_team_goal
        WHEN m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id THEN m.away_team_goal
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS total_goals
  FROM
    Team t
    JOIN Match m ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id OR t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
  GROUP BY
    t.team_api_id,
    season
),
Team_Max_Season_Goals AS (
  SELECT
    team_api_id,
    MAX(total_goals) AS max_season_goals
  FROM
    Team_Season_Goals
  GROUP BY
    team_api_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(max_season_goals) AS median_max_season_goals
FROM (
  SELECT
    max_season_goals
  FROM
    Team_Max_Season_Goals
  ORDER BY
    max_season_goals
  LIMIT 2 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Team_Max_Season_Goals) % 2  -- 2 if even count, 1 if odd
  OFFSET (SELECT (COUNT(*) - 1) / 2 FROM Team_Max_Season_Goals)
);

WITH Match_Wins AS (
    SELECT
        m.league_id,
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_id,
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win
    FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        m.league_id,
        m.away_team_api_id AS team_id,
        CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win
    FROM Match m
),
Team_League AS (
    -- All teams paired with all leagues they ever participated in a match
    SELECT DISTINCT m.league_id, m.home_team_api_id AS team_id
    FROM Match m
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT m.league_id, m.away_team_api_id AS team_id
    FROM Match m
),
Team_Wins AS (
    SELECT
        tl.league_id,
        tl.team_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(mw.win), 0) AS total_wins
    FROM Team_League tl
    LEFT JOIN Match_Wins mw
        ON tl.league_id = mw.league_id AND tl.team_id = mw.team_id
    GROUP BY tl.league_id, tl.team_id
),
Min_Wins_Per_League AS (
    SELECT
        league_id,
        MIN(total_wins) AS min_wins
    FROM Team_Wins
    GROUP BY league_id
)
SELECT
    l.name AS league_name,
    t.team_long_name AS team_name,
    tw.total_wins
FROM Min_Wins_Per_League mwpl
JOIN Team_Wins tw
    ON mwpl.league_id = tw.league_id
   AND mwpl.min_wins = tw.total_wins
JOIN League l
    ON l.id = tw.league_id
JOIN Team t
    ON t.team_api_id = tw.team_id
-- pick only a single team per league in case of ties
WHERE tw.team_id IN (
    SELECT tw2.team_id
    FROM Team_Wins tw2
    WHERE tw2.league_id = tw.league_id
    ORDER BY tw2.team_id
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY l.name;

player_win_loss AS (

WITH
season_batsman_runs AS (

    m.season,

  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.inning_no = bs.inning_no AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  GROUP BY m.season, b.player_id
),
top3_batsmen AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    player_id,
    total_runs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY season
      ORDER BY total_runs DESC, player_id ASC
    ) AS rank
  FROM season_batsman_runs
),
season_bowler_wickets AS (
  SELECT
    m.season,
    b.bowler_id AS player_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_wickets
  FROM match m
  JOIN ball_by_ball b ON m.match_id = b.match_id
  JOIN wicket_taken w ON b.match_id = w.match_id AND b.inning_no = w.inning_no AND b.over_id = w.over_id AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id
  WHERE w.kind NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
  GROUP BY m.season, b.bowler_id
),
top3_bowlers AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    player_id,
    total_wickets,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY season
      ORDER BY total_wickets DESC, player_id ASC
    ) AS rank
  FROM season_bowler_wickets
)
SELECT
  tb.season,
  tb.rank,
  tb.player_id AS batsman_id,
  tb.total_runs,
  tw.player_id AS bowler_id,
  tw.total_wickets
FROM
  top3_batsmen tb
JOIN
  top3_bowlers tw
    ON tb.season = tw.season AND tb.rank = tw.rank
WHERE
  tb.rank <= 3
ORDER BY
  tb.season ASC,
  tb.rank ASC;

WITH partnership_runs AS (
    SELECT
        bbb.match_id,
        bbb.striker AS player1_id_raw,
        bbb.non_striker AS player2_id_raw,
        SUM(batsman_scored.runs) AS striker_runs,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN batsman_scored.batsman_id = bbb.non_striker THEN batsman_scored.runs 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) AS non_striker_runs,
        SUM(batsman_scored.runs) + SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN batsman_scored.batsman_id = bbb.non_striker THEN batsman_scored.runs 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) AS total_partnership
    FROM
        ball_by_ball bbb
        JOIN batsman_scored ON bbb.match_id = batsman_scored.match_id AND bbb.inning_no = batsman_scored.inning_no AND bbb.over_id = batsman_scored.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = batsman_scored.ball_id
    GROUP BY
        bbb.match_id, bbb.striker, bbb.non_striker
),
partnership_with_scores AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN striker_runs > non_striker_runs THEN player1_id_raw
            WHEN striker_runs < non_striker_runs THEN player2_id_raw
            WHEN striker_runs = non_striker_runs AND player1_id_raw > player2_id_raw THEN player1_id_raw
            ELSE player2_id_raw
        END AS player1_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN striker_runs > non_striker_runs THEN player2_id_raw
            WHEN striker_runs < non_striker_runs THEN player1_id_raw
            WHEN striker_runs = non_striker_runs AND player1_id_raw > player2_id_raw THEN player2_id_raw
            ELSE player1_id_raw
        END AS player2_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN striker_runs > non_striker_runs THEN striker_runs
            WHEN striker_runs < non_striker_runs THEN non_striker_runs
            WHEN striker_runs = non_striker_runs AND player1_id_raw > player2_id_raw THEN striker_runs
            ELSE striker_runs
        END AS player1_runs,
        CASE 
            WHEN striker_runs > non_striker_runs THEN non_striker_runs
            WHEN striker_runs < non_striker_runs THEN striker_runs
            WHEN striker_runs = non_striker_runs AND player1_id_raw > player2_id_raw THEN non_striker_runs
            ELSE non_striker_runs
        END AS player2_runs,
        total_partnership
    FROM partnership_runs
),
max_partnership_per_match AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        MAX(total_partnership) AS max_partnership
    FROM partnership_with_scores
    GROUP BY match_id
)
SELECT
    pws.match_id,
    pws.player1_id,
    pws.player1_runs,
    pws.player2_id,
    pws.player2_runs,
    pws.total_partnership
FROM
    partnership_with_scores pws
    JOIN max_partnership_per_match mp
        ON pws.match_id = mp.match_id AND pws.total_partnership = mp.max_partnership
ORDER BY
    pws.match_id, pws.player1_id DESC, pws.player2_id DESC;

WITH movies_above_8 AS (

top_genres AS (

    JOIN genre g ON ma8.genre_id = g.id

    JOIN director_mapping d ON fm.director_id = d.id

top_directors AS (
