WITH track_stats AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(Milliseconds) AS min_ms,
        MAX(Milliseconds) AS max_ms,
        AVG(Milliseconds) AS avg_ms
    FROM Track
),
boundaries AS (
    SELECT
        min_ms,
        max_ms,
        avg_ms,
        (min_ms + avg_ms) / 2.0 AS short_upper,
        (avg_ms + max_ms) / 2.0 AS medium_upper
    FROM track_stats
),
track_classified AS (
    SELECT
        t.TrackId,
        t.Name,
        t.Milliseconds,
        -- Duration in minutes
        t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 AS duration_min,
        CASE
            WHEN t.Milliseconds BETWEEN b.min_ms AND b.short_upper THEN 'Short'
            WHEN t.Milliseconds > b.short_upper AND t.Milliseconds <= b.medium_upper THEN 'Medium'
            WHEN t.Milliseconds > b.medium_upper AND t.Milliseconds <= b.max_ms THEN 'Long'
        END AS duration_type
    FROM Track t
    CROSS JOIN boundaries b
),
track_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        tc.*,
        IFNULL(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 0) AS revenue
    FROM track_classified tc
    LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = tc.TrackId
    GROUP BY tc.TrackId
)
SELECT
    duration_type,
    MIN(duration_min) AS min_minutes,
    MAX(duration_min) AS max_minutes,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM track_revenue
WHERE duration_type IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY duration_type
ORDER BY duration_type

),

),
LocationCompanyAvg AS (

),
RankedCompanies AS (

)
SELECT

WITH valid_wickets AS (

        SUM(rc.runs_off_bat) AS total_runs_conceded,
        bo.balls_bowled,
        COUNT(vw.wicket_type) AS wickets_taken
    FROM
        runs_conceded_per_ball rc
        JOIN bowler_overs bo ON rc.bowler_id = bo.bowler_id AND rc.match_id = bo.match_id
        LEFT JOIN valid_wickets vw ON rc.bowler_id = vw.bowler_id AND rc.match_id = vw.match_id
            AND rc.over_id = (SELECT bb2.over_id FROM ball_by_ball bb2 WHERE bb2.match_id = vw.match_id AND bb2.over_id = rc.over_id AND bb2.ball_id = rc.ball_id LIMIT 1)
            AND rc.ball_id = (SELECT bb2.ball_id FROM ball_by_ball bb2 WHERE bb2.match_id = vw.match_id AND bb2.over_id = rc.over_id AND bb2.ball_id = rc.ball_id LIMIT 1)
    GROUP BY
        rc.bowler_id,
        rc.match_id
),
best_bowling_per_match AS (
    SELECT
        bowler_id,
        MAX(wickets_taken) AS max_wickets
    FROM
        bowler_match_summary
    GROUP BY
        bowler_id
),
best_bowling_full AS (
    SELECT
        bms.bowler_id,
        bms.match_id,
        bms.wickets_taken,
        bms.total_runs_conceded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bms.bowler_id ORDER BY bms.wickets_taken DESC, bms.total_runs_conceded ASC) AS rn
    FROM
        bowler_match_summary bms
        JOIN best_bowling_per_match bbpm
            ON bms.bowler_id = bbpm.bowler_id AND bms.wickets_taken = bbpm.max_wickets
)
SELECT
    p.player_name AS bowler_name,
    SUM(bms.wickets_taken) AS total_wickets,
    ROUND((SUM(bms.total_runs_conceded) * 6.0) / SUM(bms.balls_bowled), 2) AS economy_rate,
    CASE WHEN SUM(bms.wickets_taken) > 0
        THEN ROUND(CAST(SUM(bms.balls_bowled) AS REAL)/SUM(bms.wickets_taken), 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS strike_rate,
    (SELECT CAST(wickets_taken AS TEXT) || '-' || CAST(total_runs_conceded AS TEXT)
        FROM best_bowling_full bbf
        WHERE bbf.bowler_id = bms.bowler_id AND bbf.rn = 1
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS best_bowling
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            bowler_id,
            SUM(total_runs_conceded) AS total_runs_conceded,
            SUM(balls_bowled) AS balls_bowled,
            SUM(wickets_taken) AS wickets_taken
        FROM
            bowler_match_summary
        GROUP BY
            bowler_id
    ) bms
    JOIN player p ON bms.bowler_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY
    bms.bowler_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY
    total_wickets DESC, economy_rate ASC, p.player_name

WITH player_role_freq AS (
  SELECT
    pm.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    pm.role,
    COUNT(*) AS role_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pm.player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
  FROM player_match pm
  JOIN player p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.role
),
most_freq_role AS (
  SELECT player_id, role
  FROM player_role_freq
  WHERE rn = 1
),
player_bio AS (
  SELECT player_id, player_name, batting_hand, bowling_skill
  FROM player
),
runs_and_matches AS (
  SELECT
    bb.player_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bb.match_id) AS matches_played,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN bb.is_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 END) AS total_dismissals
  FROM ball_by_ball bb
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.inning_no = bs.inning_no AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  GROUP BY bb.player_id
),
highest_score AS (
  SELECT
    bb.player_id,
    bb.match_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS match_runs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bb.player_id ORDER BY SUM(bs.runs_scored) DESC) AS rn
  FROM ball_by_ball bb
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.inning_no = bs.inning_no AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  GROUP BY bb.player_id, bb.match_id
),
boundary_scores AS (
  SELECT
    bb.player_id,
    bb.match_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS match_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball bb
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.inning_no = bs.inning_no AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  GROUP BY bb.player_id, bb.match_id
),
runs_thresholds AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 30 THEN 1 END) AS matches_30,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 END) AS matches_50,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 100 THEN 1 END) AS matches_100
  FROM boundary_scores
  GROUP BY player_id
),
balls_faced AS (
  SELECT
    bb.player_id,
    COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
  FROM ball_by_ball bb
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.inning_no = bs.inning_no AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  GROUP BY bb.player_id
),
bowling_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bb.bowler_id AS player_id,
    COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_conceded
  FROM ball_by_ball bb
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.inning_no = bs.inning_no AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  GROUP BY bb.bowler_id
),
wickets_total AS (
  SELECT
    wt.bowler_id AS player_id,
    COUNT(*) AS wickets_taken
  FROM wicket_taken wt
  GROUP BY wt.bowler_id
),
bowling_performance AS (
  SELECT
    wt.bowler_id AS player_id,
    wt.match_id,
    COUNT(*) AS wickets_in_match,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_given,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY wt.bowler_id
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SUM(bs.runs_scored)
    ) AS rn
  FROM wicket_taken wt
  JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.bowler_id = bb.bowler_id AND wt.match_id = bb.match_id AND wt.inning_no = bb.inning_no
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.inning_no = bs.inning_no AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  GROUP BY wt.bowler_id, wt.match_id
)
SELECT
  pb.player_id,
  pb.player_name,
  mfr.role AS most_frequent_role,
  pb.batting_hand,
  pb.bowling_skill,
  COALESCE(rm.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs,
  COALESCE(rm.matches_played, 0) AS matches_played,
  COALESCE(rm.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_times_dismissed,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(rm.total_dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * rm.total_runs / rm.total_dismissals, 2) ELSE NULL END AS batting_average,
  COALESCE(hs.match_runs, 0) AS highest_score_single_match,
  COALESCE(rt.matches_30, 0) AS matches_scored_30plus,
  COALESCE(rt.matches_50, 0) AS matches_scored_50plus,
  COALESCE(rt.matches_100, 0) AS matches_scored_100plus,
  COALESCE(bf.balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(bf.balls_faced, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * rm.total_runs / bf.balls_faced, 2) ELSE NULL END AS strike_rate,
  COALESCE(wt.wickets_taken, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(bs.balls_bowled, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * bs.runs_conceded / bs.balls_bowled * 6, 2) ELSE NULL END AS economy_rate,
  CASE WHEN bp.wickets_in_match IS NOT NULL
    THEN CAST(bp.wickets_in_match AS TEXT) || '-' || CAST(bp.runs_given AS TEXT)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS best_bowling_performance
FROM player_bio pb
LEFT JOIN most_freq_role mfr ON pb.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN runs_and_matches rm ON pb.player_id = rm.player_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT player_id, match_runs
  FROM highest_score
  WHERE rn = 1
) hs ON pb.player_id = hs.player_id
LEFT JOIN runs_thresholds rt ON pb.player_id = rt.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls_faced bf ON pb.player_id = bf.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_stats bs ON pb.player_id = bs.player_id
LEFT JOIN wickets_total wt ON pb.player_id = wt.player_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT player_id, wickets_in_match, runs_given
  FROM bowling_performance
  WHERE rn = 1
) bp ON pb.player_id = bp.player_id
ORDER BY pb.player_id;

WITH stack_models AS (
    SELECT 
        problem_id, version, step,
        test_score AS stack_test_score
    FROM model
    WHERE model_type = 'Stack'
),
non_stack_max AS (
    SELECT 
        problem_id, version, step,
        MAX(test_score) AS max_non_stack_test_score
    FROM model
    WHERE model_type != 'Stack'
    GROUP BY problem_id, version, step
),
better_stack AS (
    SELECT 
        s.problem_id, s.version, s.step
    FROM stack_models s
    JOIN non_stack_max n
      ON s.problem_id = n.problem_id
     AND s.version = n.version
     AND s.step = n.step
    WHERE n.max_non_stack_test_score < s.stack_test_score
      AND s.step IN (1,2,3)
),
sol_probs AS (
    SELECT 
        so.problem_id,
        so.version,
        so.step
    FROM solution so
),
matching_sol AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.problem_id
    FROM sol_probs sp
    JOIN better_stack bs
      ON sp.problem_id = bs.problem_id
     AND sp.version = bs.version
     AND sp.step = bs.step
)
SELECT 
    p.id AS problem_id,
    p.name AS problem_name,
    COUNT(ms.problem_id) AS occurrence_count
FROM problem p
JOIN matching_sol ms
  ON p.id = ms.problem_id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
HAVING occurrence_count > (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*)
    FROM solution so
    WHERE so.problem_id = p.id
)

WITH non_stack_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    m.name, 
    m.version, 
    ms.step, 
    MAX(ms.test_score) AS max_non_stack_score
  FROM model_score ms
  JOIN model m ON ms.model_id = m.id
  WHERE ms.L1_model IS NOT NULL AND ms.L1_model != 'Stack'
  GROUP BY m.name, m.version, ms.step
),
stack_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    m.name, 
    m.version, 
    ms.step, 
    ms.test_score AS stack_test_score,
    ms.L1_model
  FROM model_score ms
  JOIN model m ON ms.model_id = m.id
  WHERE ms.L1_model = 'Stack'
),
model_status AS (
  SELECT
    s.name,
    s.version,
    s.step,
    s.L1_model,
    CASE 
      WHEN n.max_non_stack_score < s.stack_test_score THEN 'strong'
      WHEN n.max_non_stack_score = s.stack_test_score THEN 'soft'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS status
  FROM stack_scores s
  LEFT JOIN non_stack_scores n
    ON s.name = n.name AND s.version = n.version AND s.step = n.step
  WHERE n.max_non_stack_score IS NOT NULL
),
status_counts AS (
  SELECT
    L1_model,
    status,
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM model_status
  WHERE status IN ('strong', 'soft')
  GROUP BY L1_model, status
),
most_frequent AS (
  SELECT
    status,
    L1_model,
    count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY count DESC) as rnk
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT
  status,
  L1_model,
  count
FROM most_frequent
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY status, L1_model;

SELECT m.L1_model, COUNT(*) AS total_count
FROM model m
WHERE m.L1_model != 'Stack'
GROUP BY m.L1_model
ORDER BY total_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH RECURSIVE expanded(packaging_id, leaf_id, total_qty) AS (
  -- Start at each packaging as a root, initially qty = 1
  SELECT
    pr.packaging_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    pr.qty AS total_qty
  FROM packaging_relations pr
  UNION ALL
  -- Expand leafs: if a leaf contains more, expand those
  SELECT
    e.packaging_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    e.total_qty * pr.qty
  FROM expanded e
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON e.leaf_id = pr.packaging_id
)
, leafs AS (
  -- True leaf nodes are contains_id never acting as packaging_id
  SELECT DISTINCT e.packaging_id, e.leaf_id, SUM(e.total_qty) AS total_qty
  FROM expanded e
  LEFT JOIN packaging_relations pr2 ON e.leaf_id = pr2.packaging_id
  WHERE pr2.packaging_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY e.packaging_id, e.leaf_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_qty) AS avg_total_leaf_qty
FROM (
  SELECT packaging_id, SUM(total_qty) AS total_qty
  FROM leafs
  GROUP BY packaging_id
) t;

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_hierarchy AS (
  -- Start from all top-level packaging (not inside any other packaging)
  SELECT
    p.id AS top_packaging_id,
    p.name AS top_packaging_name,
    pr.contains_id AS packaging_id,
    pr.qty AS multiplier
  FROM packaging p
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
  WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)

  UNION ALL

  -- Traverse deeper into the hierarchy, multiplying quantities
  SELECT
    ph.top_packaging_id,
    ph.top_packaging_name,
    pr.contains_id,
    ph.multiplier * pr.qty
  FROM packaging_hierarchy ph
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON ph.packaging_id = pr.packaging_id
)
, packaging_to_product AS (
  -- Find products directly contained in lowest-level packaging
  SELECT
    ph.top_packaging_id,
    ph.top_packaging_name,
    inv.product_id,
    ph.multiplier * inv.qty AS total_qty
  FROM packaging_hierarchy ph
  JOIN inventory inv ON ph.packaging_id = inv.id
)
, total_qty_accumulated AS (
  -- Aggregate quantity for each top-level packaging and product
  SELECT
    top_packaging_id,
    top_packaging_name,
    product_id,
    SUM(total_qty) AS accumulated_qty
  FROM packaging_to_product
  GROUP BY top_packaging_id, top_packaging_name, product_id
)
SELECT
  tqa.top_packaging_name AS packaging_name,
  prod.name AS product_name,
  tqa.accumulated_qty
FROM total_qty_accumulated tqa
JOIN products prod ON tqa.product_id = prod.id
WHERE tqa.accumulated_qty > 500
ORDER BY tqa.top_packaging_name, prod.name;

WITH order_details AS (
    SELECT
        ol.product_id,
        ol.qty AS ordered_qty,
        ol.orderline_id
    FROM orderlines ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_id = 423
    ORDER BY ol.product_id, ol.orderline_id
),
order_lines_cum AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        orderline_id,
        ordered_qty,
        SUM(ordered_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY orderline_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_order_qty
    FROM order_details
),
inv_by_loc AS (
    SELECT
        s.product_id,
        s.aisle,
        s.position,
        s.qty AS available_qty,
        i.purchase_date
    FROM stock s
    JOIN inventory i ON s.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    WHERE s.warehouse_id = 1 AND s.qty > 0
),
inv_priority AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY i.purchase_date, s.qty) AS inv_priority_order
    FROM stock s
    JOIN inventory i ON s.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    WHERE s.warehouse_id = 1 AND s.qty > 0
),
product_inv AS (
    SELECT
        s.product_id,
        s.aisle,
        s.position,
        s.qty AS available_qty,
        i.purchase_date,
        SUM(s.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY s.product_id ORDER BY i.purchase_date, s.qty ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_inv_qty,
        s.inventory_id
    FROM stock s
    JOIN inventory i ON s.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    WHERE s.warehouse_id = 1 AND s.qty > 0
),
assigned_picking AS (
    SELECT
        olc.product_id,
        olc.orderline_id,
        olc.ordered_qty,
        olc.cum_order_qty,
        pi.aisle,
        pi.position,
        pi.purchase_date,
        pi.available_qty,
        pi.inventory_id,
        pi.cum_inv_qty,
        -- Calculate how much needs to be picked from this inventory location for this order line
        -- This is the overlap between what is needed for this order line (up to cum_order_qty)
        -- and what is available at this inventory location (up to cum_inv_qty)
        MAX(0,
            MIN(
                pi.cum_inv_qty,
                olc.cum_order_qty
            ) - 
            MAX(
                pi.cum_inv_qty - pi.available_qty,
                olc.cum_order_qty - olc.ordered_qty
            )
        ) AS pick_qty
    FROM order_lines_cum olc
    JOIN product_inv pi ON olc.product_id = pi.product_id
    WHERE MIN(
            pi.cum_inv_qty,
            olc.cum_order_qty
        ) - 
        MAX(
            pi.cum_inv_qty - pi.available_qty,
            olc.cum_order_qty - olc.ordered_qty
        ) > 0
),
final_pick AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        orderline_id,
        aisle,
        position,
        purchase_date,
        pick_qty
    FROM assigned_picking
    WHERE pick_qty > 0
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    orderline_id,
    aisle,
    position,
    pick_qty
FROM final_pick
ORDER BY product_id, orderline_id, purchase_date, pick_qty;

WITH inventory_fifo AS (
  SELECT 
    i.product_id,
    i.location_id,
    i.quantity AS available_qty,
    i.purchase_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY i.purchase_date ASC, i.quantity ASC) AS fifo_rank
  FROM inventory i
),
orderlines_expanded AS (
  SELECT 
    o.id AS order_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.quantity AS order_qty
  FROM orderlines ol
  JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.id
),
match_fifo AS (
  SELECT
    oe.order_id,
    oe.product_id,
    oe.order_qty,
    inv.location_id,
    inv.available_qty,
    inv.purchase_date,
    inv.fifo_rank,
    -- The picked quantity is the overlapping amount between what the order needs and what the inventory location can provide
    CASE 
      WHEN oe.order_qty <= inv.available_qty THEN oe.order_qty
      ELSE inv.available_qty
    END AS picked_qty
  FROM orderlines_expanded oe
  JOIN inventory_fifo inv
    ON oe.product_id = inv.product_id
  -- Only consider inventory available at the time of order (optional, as there's no timestamp on the order)
)
, product_pick_stats AS (
  SELECT
    m.product_id,
    SUM(m.picked_qty) AS total_picked,
    SUM(m.order_qty) AS total_ordered
  FROM match_fifo m
  GROUP BY m.product_id
)
SELECT
  p.name AS product_name,
  CASE WHEN SUM(ps.total_ordered) > 0 THEN 
    CAST(SUM(ps.total_picked) AS FLOAT) / SUM(ps.total_ordered)
  ELSE 0
  END AS avg_pick_percentage
FROM product_pick_stats ps
JOIN products p ON ps.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY p.name;

WITH fifo_picks AS (
  SELECT
    pl.product_id,
    pl.picking_list_id,
    pl.order_id,
    pl.qty_picked,
    pl.created_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pl.product_id, pl.order_id
      ORDER BY pl.created_at ASC, pl.picking_list_id ASC
    ) as fifo_rank
  FROM picking_line pl
  WHERE pl.order_id = 421
),
picked_products AS (
  SELECT
    fp.product_id,
    SUM(fp.qty_picked) AS total_units_picked,
    COUNT(*) AS pick_events,
    AVG(fp.qty_picked*1.0) AS avg_units_picked
  FROM fifo_picks fp
  GROUP BY fp.product_id
)
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  prod.product_name,
  picked_products.total_units_picked,
  picked_products.avg_units_picked
FROM picked_products
JOIN products prod ON picked_products.product_id = prod.product_id
ORDER BY p.product_id;

WITH monthly_product_sales AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) AS year_month,
    products.product_id,
    SUM(orderlines.quantity) AS total_sales
  FROM
    orders
    JOIN orderlines ON orders.order_id = orderlines.order_id
    JOIN products ON orderlines.product_id = products.product_id
  WHERE
    orders.order_date >= '2016-01-01'
  GROUP BY
    products.product_id, year_month
),
-- Assign a row number to each (product_id, year_month) partition for time ordering
ordered_sales AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY year_month) AS rn
  FROM
    monthly_product_sales
),
-- For each month, calculate two overlapping 12-month moving averages
cma_calc AS (
  SELECT
    a.product_id,
    a.year_month,
    a.total_sales,
    -- First window: 5 months before (rn-5) to 6 months after (rn+6)
    (SELECT AVG(total_sales)
     FROM ordered_sales z
     WHERE z.product_id = a.product_id AND z.rn BETWEEN a.rn-5 AND a.rn+6
    ) AS cma1,
    -- Second window: 6 months before (rn-6) to 5 months after (rn+5)
    (SELECT AVG(total_sales)
     FROM ordered_sales z
     WHERE z.product_id = a.product_id AND z.rn BETWEEN a.rn-6 AND a.rn+5
    ) AS cma2,
    a.rn
  FROM ordered_sales a
),
-- Take the average of the two CMAs as the final CMA
cma_final AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    year_month,
    total_sales,
    (COALESCE(cma1,0) + COALESCE(cma2,0))/2.0 AS cma,
    rn
  FROM
    cma_calc
),
-- Calculate the sales-to-CMA ratio and restrict to months 7~30 after Jan 2016
ratio_2017 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUBSTR(year_month, 1, 4) AS year,
    SUBSTR(year_month, 6, 2) AS month,
    CASE WHEN cma > 0 THEN total_sales / cma ELSE NULL END AS sales_to_cma_ratio
  FROM
    cma_final
  WHERE
    rn BETWEEN 7 AND 30
    AND year = '2017'
),
product_above_2 AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    COUNT(*) AS months_with_ratio_gt_2
  FROM
    ratio_2017
  WHERE
    sales_to_cma_ratio > 2
  GROUP BY
    product_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 12  -- Must be true for all 12 months of 2017
)
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name
FROM
  products p
  JOIN product_above_2 pa2 ON p.product_id = pa2.product_id
ORDER BY
  p.product_id;

WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS year_month,
    SUM(amount) AS monthly_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_date)) AS month_num
  FROM orderlines
  JOIN orders ON orderlines.order_id = orders.order_id
  WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
    AND order_date >= '2016-01-01'
    AND order_date < '2019-01-01'
  GROUP BY product_id, year_month
),
-- Step 1: Calculate Centered Moving Average (CMA) for each month (window: 5 before + 6 after and 6 before + 5 after)
cma_calc AS (
  SELECT
    sd1.product_id,
    sd1.year_month,
    sd1.month_num,
    sd1.monthly_sales,
    (
      -- Average of two overlapping 12-month windows centered at current month
      (
        COALESCE((SELECT AVG(monthly_sales)
                  FROM sales_data sd2
                  WHERE sd2.product_id = sd1.product_id AND sd2.month_num BETWEEN (sd1.month_num-5) AND (sd1.month_num+6)), 0)
      +
        COALESCE((SELECT AVG(monthly_sales)
                  FROM sales_data sd3
                  WHERE sd3.product_id = sd1.product_id AND sd3.month_num BETWEEN (sd1.month_num-6) AND (sd1.month_num+5)), 0)
      )/2.0 AS cma
    FROM sales_data sd1
),
-- Step 2: Restrict to months 7 - 30 for seasonality/ratio modeling
seasonality_range AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    (monthly_sales / NULLIF(cma,0)) AS sales_to_cma_ratio
  FROM cma_calc
  WHERE month_num BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
-- Step 3: Estimate seasonality multiplicative index for each of 12 calendar months (using average sales-to-CMA ratio)
seasonality_index AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    CAST(substr(year_month,6,2) AS INTEGER) as month_num_in_year,
    AVG(sales_to_cma_ratio) AS seasonality_factor
  FROM seasonality_range
  GROUP BY product_id, month_num_in_year
),
-- Step 4: Prepare regressor input (dependent: monthly_sales / seasonality_factor, independent: time index)
deseasonalized AS (
  SELECT
    sr.product_id,
    sr.month_num,
    sr.monthly_sales / NULLIF(si.seasonality_factor,0) AS deseasonalized_sales
  FROM seasonality_range sr
  JOIN seasonality_index si
    ON sr.product_id = si.product_id
   AND CAST(substr(sr.year_month,6,2) AS INTEGER) = si.month_num_in_year
),
-- Step 5: Regression coefficients (weighted regression: weight is seasonality factor)
regression_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.product_id,
    COUNT(*) as N,
    SUM(month_num) as Sx,
    SUM(deseasonalized_sales) as Sy,
    SUM(month_num * deseasonalized_sales) as Sxy,
    SUM(month_num * month_num) as Sxx
  FROM deseasonalized d
  GROUP BY d.product_id
),
regression_coeffs AS (
  SELECT
    r.product_id,
    -- Intercept (a): (Sy*Sxx - Sx*Sxy) / (N*Sxx - Sx*Sx)
    (r.Sy * r.Sxx - r.Sx * r.Sxy) * 1.0 / NULLIF((r.N * r.Sxx - r.Sx * r.Sx),0) AS intercept,
    -- Slope (b): (N*Sxy - Sx*Sy) / (N*Sxx - Sx*Sx)
    (r.N * r.Sxy - r.Sx * r.Sy) * 1.0 / NULLIF((r.N * r.Sxx - r.Sx * r.Sx),0) AS slope
  FROM regression_stats r
),
-- Step 6: Forecast for 2018 (months 25~36, i.e. Jan~Dec 2018 since starting from Jan 2016), add back seasonality
forecast_months AS (
  SELECT product_id, (m + 24) AS month_num_2018, m AS forecast_month
  FROM (SELECT 1 m UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6
        UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12)
),
-- join monthly seasonality index for each forecast month
forecast_with_seasonality AS (
  SELECT
    fm.product_id,
    fm.forecast_month,
    rc.intercept + rc.slope * fm.month_num_2018 AS forecast_deseasonalized,
    si.seasonality_factor,
    (rc.intercept + rc.slope * fm.month_num_2018) * si.seasonality_factor AS forecasted_sales
  FROM forecast_months fm
  JOIN regression_coeffs rc ON rc.product_id = fm.product_id
  JOIN seasonality_index si
    ON si.product_id = fm.product_id
   AND si.month_num_in_year = fm.forecast_month
)
-- Step 7: Compute average forecasted annual sales for 2018 for each product
SELECT
  product_id,
  AVG(forecasted_sales) AS avg_forecasted_annual_sales_2018
FROM forecast_with_seasonality
GROUP BY product_id

WITH
-- Get minimum required inventory per product
product_min AS (
  SELECT product_id, minimum
  FROM product_minimums
),
-- December 2018 ending inventory per product
dec18_inventory AS (
  SELECT
    s.product_id,
    SUM(s.quantity) AS end_inventory
  FROM stock s
  WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', s.date) = '2018-12'
  GROUP BY s.product_id
),
-- Get all orders per product/month in 2019
order_outflow AS (
  SELECT
    o.product_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', ord.order_date) AS ym,
    SUM(o.quantity) AS sold_qty
  FROM orderlines o
  JOIN orders ord ON o.order_id = ord.order_id
  WHERE strftime('%Y', ord.order_date) = '2019'
  GROUP BY o.product_id, ym
),
-- Generate months in 2019
months AS (
  SELECT '2019-01' AS ym UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-02' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-03' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-04' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-05' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-06' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-07' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-08' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-09' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-10' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-11' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-12'
),
-- Prepare inventory calculation per product/month recursively
inventory_sim AS (
  -- Anchor: Jan 2019, start from Dec 2018 end_inventory
  SELECT
    pm.product_id,
    m.ym,
    COALESCE(d.end_inventory, 0) AS begin_inventory,
    pm.minimum,
    COALESCE(o.sold_qty, 0) AS sold_qty,
    CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS restocked_qty,
    NULL AS end_inventory
  FROM product_min pm
  CROSS JOIN months m
  LEFT JOIN dec18_inventory d ON pm.product_id = d.product_id
  LEFT JOIN order_outflow o ON pm.product_id = o.product_id AND m.ym = '2019-01'
  WHERE m.ym = '2019-01'

  UNION ALL

  -- Recursive: from previous month's result
  SELECT
    inv.product_id,
    m.ym,
    -- previous month's ending inventory
    inv.end_inventory,
    inv.minimum,
    COALESCE(o.sold_qty, 0) AS sold_qty,
    CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS restocked_qty,
    NULL AS end_inventory
  FROM inventory_sim inv
  JOIN months m
    ON julianday(m.ym || '-01') = julianday(inv.ym || '-01', '+1 month')
  LEFT JOIN order_outflow o ON inv.product_id = o.product_id AND m.ym = m.ym
)
,
-- Actually calculate restocked_amt and simulated ending inventory
rec_inventory_sim AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    ym,
    begin_inventory,
    minimum,
    sold_qty,
    -- If after outflow, ending inventory < minimum, restock by the difference
    CASE
      WHEN (begin_inventory - sold_qty) < minimum THEN minimum - (begin_inventory - sold_qty)
      ELSE 0
    END AS restocked_qty,
    -- Simulated ending inventory after restock
    (CASE
      WHEN (begin_inventory - sold_qty) < minimum THEN minimum
      ELSE (begin_inventory - sold_qty)
    END) AS end_inventory
  FROM (
    SELECT *,
      -- Use LAG window to plug in previously-calced end_inventory as the begin_inventory for next month
      LAG(end_inventory) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ym) as lagged_end_inventory
    FROM (
      -- Replace begin_inventory for months > '2019-01' with lagged value from recursive CTE
      SELECT *, 
        CASE WHEN ym = '2019-01' THEN begin_inventory ELSE NULL END as true_begin_inventory
      FROM inventory_sim
    )
  )
  -- Replace NULL begin_inventory with lagged value (from window function) for months after Jan
  -- so each month uses previous ending inventory
)
,
-- Recurse across all 12 months by joining previous month, so that begin_inventory flows
recursive_full AS (
  -- Jan 2019: Use Dec 2018 for begin_inventory
  SELECT
    pm.product_id,
    m.ym,
    COALESCE(di.end_inventory,0) AS begin_inventory,
    pm.minimum,
    COALESCE(o.sold_qty,0) AS sold_qty
  FROM product_min pm
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT ym FROM months WHERE ym = '2019-01') m
  LEFT JOIN dec18_inventory di ON pm.product_id=di.product_id
  LEFT JOIN order_outflow o ON pm.product_id = o.product_id AND o.ym=m.ym

  UNION ALL

  -- All next months
  SELECT
    rf.product_id,
    m_next.ym,
    -- begin_inventory = last month's end_inventory
    (CASE
      WHEN ((rf.begin_inventory - rf.sold_qty)<rf.minimum)
        THEN rf.minimum
        ELSE (rf.begin_inventory - rf.sold_qty)
    END) AS begin_inventory,
    rf.minimum,
    COALESCE(o.sold_qty,0) AS sold_qty
  FROM recursive_full rf
  JOIN months m_next ON julianday(m_next.ym||'-01')=julianday(rf.ym||'-01','+1 month')
  LEFT JOIN order_outflow o ON rf.product_id=o.product_id AND o.ym=m_next.ym
  WHERE m_next.ym>'2019-01'
),
-- Calculate post-sale, post-restock inventory per month
ending_inventory AS (
  SELECT
    rf.product_id,
    rf.ym,
    rf.begin_inventory,
    rf.sold_qty,
    rf.minimum,
    -- Add restock if under minimum; else zero
    CASE
      WHEN (rf.begin_inventory - rf.sold_qty) < rf.minimum THEN rf.minimum - (rf.begin_inventory - rf.sold_qty)
      ELSE 0
    END AS restocked,
    -- Ending inventory after possible restock
    CASE
      WHEN (rf.begin_inventory - rf.sold_qty) < rf.minimum THEN rf.minimum
      ELSE (rf.begin_inventory - rf.sold_qty)
    END AS end_inventory
  FROM recursive_full rf
)
,
abs_diff_per_month AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    ym,
    ABS(end_inventory - minimum) AS abs_diff
  FROM ending_inventory
)
,
min_diff_month AS (
  SELECT
    a.product_id,
    a.ym,
    a.abs_diff,
    -- Rank months for each product by the smallest abs_diff
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.product_id ORDER BY a.abs_diff, a.ym) as rn
  FROM abs_diff_per_month a
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  ym AS best_month,
  abs_diff
FROM min_diff_month
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_id;

WITH match_points AS (
  SELECT
    M.season,
    M.league_id,
    CASE
      WHEN M.home_team_goal > M.away_team_goal THEN M.home_team_api_id
      WHEN M.home_team_goal < M.away_team_goal THEN M.away_team_api_id
      ELSE NULL
    END AS winner_team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN M.home_team_goal > M.away_team_goal THEN M.away_team_api_id
      WHEN M.home_team_goal < M.away_team_goal THEN M.home_team_api_id
      ELSE NULL
    END AS loser_team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal THEN M.home_team_api_id
    END AS tie_home_team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal THEN M.away_team_api_id
    END AS tie_away_team_id
  FROM Match M
),
points_by_team AS (
  SELECT
    mp.season,
    mp.league_id,
    mp.winner_team_id AS team_id,
    3 AS points
  FROM match_points mp
  WHERE mp.winner_team_id IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    mp.season,
    mp.league_id,
    mp.tie_home_team_id AS team_id,
    1 AS points
  FROM match_points mp
  WHERE mp.tie_home_team_id IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    mp.season,
    mp.league_id,
    mp.tie_away_team_id AS team_id,
    1 AS points
  FROM match_points mp
  WHERE mp.tie_away_team_id IS NOT NULL
),
agg_points AS (
  SELECT
    pbt.season,
    pbt.league_id,
    pbt.team_id,
    SUM(pbt.points) AS total_points
  FROM points_by_team pbt
  GROUP BY pbt.season, pbt.league_id, pbt.team_id
),
champions AS (
  SELECT
    ap.season,
    ap.league_id,
    ap.team_id,
    ap.total_points,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.season, ap.league_id ORDER BY ap.total_points DESC) AS team_rank
  FROM agg_points ap
)
SELECT
  c.season,
  T.team_long_name AS champion_team,
  L.name AS league,
  Cn.name AS country,
  c.total_points
FROM champions c
JOIN Team T ON c.team_id = T.team_api_id
JOIN League L ON c.league_id = L.id
JOIN Country Cn ON L.country_id = Cn.id
WHERE c.team_rank = 1
ORDER BY c.season, country, league;

WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(loss_rate) AS avg_loss_rate,
        STDDEV(loss_rate) AS std_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
categorized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN loss_rate < (avg_loss_rate - std_loss_rate) THEN 'below_one_std'
            WHEN loss_rate > (avg_loss_rate + std_loss_rate) THEN 'above_one_std'
            ELSE 'within_one_std'
        END AS loss_rate_category
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df, stats
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_loss_rate FROM stats) AS average_loss_rate,
    (SELECT std_loss_rate FROM stats) AS std_dev_loss_rate,
    SUM(loss_rate_category = 'below_one_std') AS count_below_one_std,
    SUM(loss_rate_category = 'within_one_std') AS count_within_one_std,
    SUM(loss_rate_category = 'above_one_std') AS count_above_one_std
FROM categorized;

SELECT
  strftime('%Y', date) AS year,
  category,
  ROUND(AVG(whsle_price), 2) AS avg_whsle_price,
  ROUND(MAX(whsle_price), 2) AS max_whsle_price,
  ROUND(MIN(whsle_price), 2) AS min_whsle_price,
  ROUND(MAX(whsle_price) - MIN(whsle_price), 2) AS whsle_price_diff,
  ROUND(SUM(whsle_price), 2) AS total_whsle_price,
  ROUND(SUM(sell_price), 2) AS total_selling_price,
  ROUND(AVG(loss_rate), 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
  ROUND(SUM(loss), 2) AS total_loss,
  ROUND(SUM(sell_price) - SUM(whsle_price), 2) AS profit
FROM veg_whsle_df
WHERE strftime('%Y', date) BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
GROUP BY year, category
ORDER BY year, category;

WITH seller_sales AS (
    SELECT
        oi.seller_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_products_sold,
        SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) AS total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) AS avg_item_price
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_reviews AS (
    SELECT
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(CAST(orv.review_score AS FLOAT)) AS avg_review_score
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN order_reviews orv ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing_times AS (
    SELECT
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(julianday(o.shipping_limit_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_packing_time_days
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_category_name,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_category_quantity
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_category_name
),
top_categories AS (
    SELECT
        cst.product_category_name,
        pct.product_category_name_english,
        cst.total_category_quantity,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cst.total_category_quantity DESC) AS category_rank
    FROM category_sales cst
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON cst.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
)
SELECT
    s.seller_id,
    se.seller_city,
    se.seller_state,
    ss.total_products_sold,
    ss.total_sales,
    ss.avg_item_price,
    sr.avg_review_score,
    spt.avg_packing_time_days,
    tc.product_category_name_english AS top_category_english,
    tc.total_category_quantity AS top_category_sales_volume
FROM sellers se
JOIN seller_sales ss ON se.seller_id = ss.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_reviews sr ON se.seller_id = sr.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_packing_times spt ON se.seller_id = spt.seller_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        oi.seller_id,
        pct.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_category_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC) AS rn
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, p.product_category_name
) tc ON se.seller_id = tc.seller_id AND tc.rn = 1
WHERE ss.total_products_sold > 100
ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC;

WITH monthly_txn AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m-01', transaction_date) AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'deposit' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS net_amount
    FROM bitcoin_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
),
cumulative_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month,
        net_amount,
        SUM(net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS closing_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month DESC) AS rn_desc
    FROM monthly_txn
),
recent_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month AS recent_month,
        closing_balance AS recent_balance,
        LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month DESC) = 1 AS is_most_recent
    FROM cumulative_balances
),
growth_rates AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        recent_month,
        recent_balance,
        prev_balance,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_balance = 0 OR prev_balance IS NULL THEN recent_balance * 100.0
            ELSE ((recent_balance - prev_balance) * 100.0 / prev_balance)
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM recent_balances
    WHERE is_most_recent
),
customer_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS total_customers
    FROM growth_rates
),
high_growth_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS high_growth_customers
    FROM growth_rates
    WHERE growth_rate > 5
)
SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * high_growth_customers / total_customers, 2) AS percent_customers_above_5pct_growth
FROM high_growth_count, customer_count;

WITH monthly_user_balances AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(strftime('%Y-%m-01', created_at)) as month_start,
    user_id,
    CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance END as non_negative_balance
  FROM shopping_cart_users
),
total_balance_per_month AS (
  SELECT
    month_start,
    SUM(non_negative_balance) AS total_balance
  FROM monthly_user_balances
  GROUP BY month_start
),
previous_month_balance AS (
  SELECT
    t1.month_start,
    t1.total_balance AS current_month_balance,
    LAG(t1.total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY t1.month_start) AS previous_month_total_balance
  FROM total_balance_per_month t1
)
SELECT
  month_start,
  previous_month_total_balance AS total_balance_previous_month
FROM previous_month_balance
WHERE previous_month_total_balance IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month_start ASC;

WITH txn AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        DATE(txn_date) AS txn_date,
        amount,
        transaction_type
    FROM customer_transactions
),
signed_txn AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        CASE
            WHEN transaction_type = 'deposit' THEN amount
            ELSE -amount
        END AS net_amount
    FROM txn
),
days AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        txn_date
    FROM signed_txn
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
calendar AS (
    -- Produce every date from first to last transaction per customer
    SELECT
        d.customer_id,
        dd.txn_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            customer_id,
            MIN(txn_date) AS min_date,
            MAX(txn_date) AS max_date
        FROM signed_txn
        GROUP BY customer_id
    ) d
    JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT txn_date
        FROM signed_txn
    ) dd
    ON dd.txn_date BETWEEN d.min_date AND d.max_date
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM signed_txn) c
    WHERE d.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
per_day_txn AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.txn_date,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.net_amount), 0) AS net_amount
    FROM calendar c
    LEFT JOIN signed_txn s
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
     AND c.txn_date = s.txn_date
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.txn_date
),
running_balance AS (
    SELECT
        p.customer_id,
        p.txn_date,
        SUM(p2.net_amount) AS balance
    FROM per_day_txn p
    JOIN per_day_txn p2
        ON p.customer_id = p2.customer_id
       AND p2.txn_date <= p.txn_date
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, p.txn_date
),
rolling_30d AS (
    SELECT
        r.customer_id,
        r.txn_date,
        AVG(CASE WHEN rb.balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE rb.balance END) AS rolling_avg_30d
    FROM running_balance r
    JOIN running_balance rb
      ON r.customer_id = rb.customer_id
     AND rb.txn_date BETWEEN DATE(r.txn_date, '-29 days') AND r.txn_date
    GROUP BY r.customer_id, r.txn_date
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 30
),
date_info AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS ym,
        MIN(strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date)) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS baseline_ym
    FROM rolling_30d
),
rolling_with_months AS (
    SELECT
        r.customer_id,
        r.txn_date,
        di.ym,
        di.baseline_ym,
        r.rolling_avg_30d
    FROM rolling_30d r
    JOIN date_info di
      ON r.customer_id = di.customer_id
     AND r.txn_date = di.txn_date
),
max_rolling_by_month AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        ym,
        MAX(rolling_avg_30d) AS max_rolling_avg_30d,
        baseline_ym
    FROM rolling_with_months
    GROUP BY customer_id, ym
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM max_rolling_by_month
    WHERE ym != baseline_ym
)
SELECT
    ym AS month,
    SUM(max_rolling_avg_30d) AS summed_max_rolling_30d_avg_balance
FROM filtered
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym;

WITH txn_dates AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MIN(date) AS min_date,
        MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
calendar AS (
    SELECT
        t.customer_id,
        date(
            t.min_date,
            printf('+%d day', n)
        ) AS calendar_date,
        t.min_date,
        t.max_date
    FROM txn_dates t
    JOIN (
        SELECT
            a.customer_id,
            b.n
        FROM txn_dates a
        JOIN (
            SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3
            UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7
            UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11
            UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
            UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19
            UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23
            UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL SELECT 25 UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27
            UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29 UNION ALL SELECT 30 UNION ALL SELECT 31
            UNION ALL SELECT 32 UNION ALL SELECT 33 UNION ALL SELECT 34 UNION ALL SELECT 35
            UNION ALL SELECT 36 UNION ALL SELECT 37 UNION ALL SELECT 38 UNION ALL SELECT 39
            UNION ALL SELECT 40 UNION ALL SELECT 41 UNION ALL SELECT 42 UNION ALL SELECT 43
            UNION ALL SELECT 44 UNION ALL SELECT 45 UNION ALL SELECT 46 UNION ALL SELECT 47
            UNION ALL SELECT 48 UNION ALL SELECT 49
        ) b
        WHERE b.n <= julianday(a.max_date) - julianday(a.min_date)
    ) x ON t.customer_id = x.customer_id
),
txns AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        date,
        SUM(amount) AS net_txn
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, date
),
full_calendar AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.calendar_date
    FROM calendar c
),
balance_calc AS (
    SELECT
        fc.customer_id,
        fc.calendar_date,
        COALESCE(tx.net_txn, 0) AS net_txn
    FROM full_calendar fc
    LEFT JOIN txns tx
      ON fc.customer_id = tx.customer_id
     AND fc.calendar_date = tx.date
),
-- Recursive running balance
running_balance AS (
    -- Anchor (first day, balance is that day's net_txn)
    SELECT
        b.customer_id,
        b.calendar_date,
        b.net_txn AS balance
    FROM balance_calc b
    WHERE b.calendar_date = (
        SELECT MIN(c2.calendar_date)
        FROM balance_calc c2
        WHERE c2.customer_id = b.customer_id
    )
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursion: add today's net_txn to yesterday's balance
    SELECT
        b.customer_id,
        b.calendar_date,
        CASE WHEN (r.balance + b.net_txn) < 0 THEN 0 ELSE (r.balance + b.net_txn) END AS balance
    FROM balance_calc b
    JOIN running_balance r
      ON b.customer_id = r.customer_id
     AND date(b.calendar_date) = date(r.calendar_date, '+1 day')
)
,
-- For each customer and month, pick max daily
monthly_max_balance AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', calendar_date) AS month,
        MAX(CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance END) AS max_daily_balance
    FROM running_balance
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
)
SELECT
    month,
    SUM(max_daily_balance) AS monthly_total_max_daily_balances
FROM monthly_max_balance
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

WITH june15_refs AS (
  SELECT 
    '2018' AS year,
    date('2018-06-15') AS june15
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019', date('2019-06-15')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2020', date('2020-06-15')
),
tagged_sales AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y', week_date) AS year,
    date(week_date) AS week_date,
    sales,
    CASE
      WHEN date(week_date) BETWEEN date(june15, '-28 days') AND date(june15, '-1 days') THEN 'before'
      WHEN date(week_date) BETWEEN june15 AND date(june15, '+27 days') THEN 'after'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS period
  FROM weekly_sales
  JOIN june15_refs ON strftime('%Y', week_date) = june15_refs.year
),
agg_sales AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    period,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM tagged_sales
  WHERE period IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, period
)
SELECT
  before.year,
  before.total_sales AS sales_4wks_before,
  after.total_sales AS sales_4wks_after,
  ROUND(
    CAST(after.total_sales - before.total_sales AS REAL) / NULLIF(before.total_sales,0) * 100, 
    2
  ) AS pct_change
FROM agg_sales before
JOIN agg_sales after
  ON before.year = after.year
WHERE before.period = 'before' AND after.period = 'after'
ORDER BY before.year;

WITH boundary_dates AS (
    SELECT
        DATE('2020-06-15', '-12 weeks') AS pre_start,
        DATE('2020-06-15', '-1 day') AS pre_end,
        DATE('2020-06-15') AS post_start,
        DATE('2020-06-15', '+11 weeks') AS post_end
),
sales_by_attr_and_period AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        platform,
        age_band,
        demographic,
        customer_type,
        CASE 
            WHEN week_date BETWEEN (SELECT pre_start FROM boundary_dates) AND (SELECT pre_end FROM boundary_dates) THEN 'pre'
            WHEN week_date BETWEEN (SELECT post_start FROM boundary_dates) AND (SELECT post_end FROM boundary_dates) THEN 'post'
        END AS period,
        SUM(sales) AS total_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales, boundary_dates
    WHERE week_date BETWEEN (SELECT pre_start FROM boundary_dates) AND (SELECT post_end FROM boundary_dates)
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type, period
),
sales_pct_change_by_attrvalue AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        platform,
        age_band,
        demographic,
        customer_type,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN total_sales END),0) AS pre_sales,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'post' THEN total_sales END),0) AS post_sales,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN total_sales END) > 0
            THEN 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'post' THEN total_sales END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN total_sales END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN total_sales END)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS pct_change
    FROM sales_by_attr_and_period
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
attribute_type_avg_change AS (
    SELECT 'region' AS attribute_type, AVG(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change FROM (SELECT region, AVG(pct_change) AS pct_change FROM sales_pct_change_by_attrvalue WHERE region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'platform', AVG(pct_change) FROM (SELECT platform, AVG(pct_change) AS pct_change FROM sales_pct_change_by_attrvalue WHERE platform IS NOT NULL GROUP BY platform)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'age_band', AVG(pct_change) FROM (SELECT age_band, AVG(pct_change) AS pct_change FROM sales_pct_change_by_attrvalue WHERE age_band IS NOT NULL GROUP BY age_band)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'demographic', AVG(pct_change) FROM (SELECT demographic, AVG(pct_change) AS pct_change FROM sales_pct_change_by_attrvalue WHERE demographic IS NOT NULL GROUP BY demographic)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'customer_type', AVG(pct_change) FROM (SELECT customer_type, AVG(pct_change) AS pct_change FROM sales_pct_change_by_attrvalue WHERE customer_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_type)
)
SELECT
    attribute_type,
    avg_pct_change,
    CASE WHEN avg_pct_change = (
        SELECT MIN(avg_pct_change)
        FROM attribute_type_avg_change
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_highest_negative_impact
FROM attribute_type_avg_change
ORDER BY is_highest_negative_impact DESC, avg_pct_change ASC;

WITH laps_with_pos AS (
  SELECT
    lt.raceId,
    lt.driverId,
    lt.lap,
    lt.position,
    ls.status AS driver_status
  FROM lap_times lt
  LEFT JOIN results r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId AND lt.driverId = r.driverId
  LEFT JOIN status ls ON r.statusId = ls.statusId
),
overtake_candidates AS (
  -- Identify overtakes: when a driver was ahead of another on previous lap, but now behind
  SELECT
    curr.raceId,
    curr.lap,
    curr.driverId AS overtaker,
    prev.driverId AS overtaken,
    curr.position AS overtaker_pos,
    prev.position AS overtaken_pos,
    curr.driver_status AS overtaker_status,
    prev.driver_status AS overtaken_status
  FROM laps_with_pos curr
  JOIN laps_with_pos prev
    ON curr.raceId = prev.raceId
    AND curr.lap = prev.lap
    AND curr.driverId != prev.driverId
    -- Overtaker is now behind, but wasn't in the prior lap
    -- Get previous lap position for each driver
    JOIN laps_with_pos curr_prevlap
      ON curr.raceId = curr_prevlap.raceId
      AND curr.driverId = curr_prevlap.driverId
      AND curr.lap = curr_prevlap.lap + 1
    JOIN laps_with_pos prev_prevlap
      ON prev.raceId = prev_prevlap.raceId
      AND prev.driverId = prev_prevlap.driverId
      AND prev.lap = prev_prevlap.lap + 1
    -- Overtaker not behind on prior lap (ahead or equal)
    WHERE curr_prevlap.position <= prev_prevlap.position
      -- Overtaker now behind
      AND curr.position > prev.position
),
pit_entries AS (
  -- Find pit entries (drivers who pitted this lap)
  SELECT raceId, driverId, lap
  FROM pit_stops
), 
pit_exits AS (
  -- Find pit exits (drivers who pitted last lap)
  SELECT raceId, driverId, lap+1 AS lap
  FROM pit_stops
),
race_start_grid AS (
  -- Find grid positions of drivers at race start
  SELECT r.raceId, r.driverId, r.grid
  FROM results r
)
SELECT
  label,
  COUNT(*) AS overtake_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.raceId,
    o.lap,
    o.overtaker,
    o.overtaken,
    -- Classification
    CASE
      -- R: Retired this lap
      WHEN o.overtaken_status LIKE '%Retired%'
        AND (SELECT MAX(lap) FROM laps_with_pos l2 WHERE l2.raceId = o.raceId AND l2.driverId = o.overtaken) = o.lap
      THEN 'R'
      -- P: Pit entry - overtaken pitted this lap
      WHEN (SELECT 1 FROM pit_entries pe WHERE pe.raceId = o.raceId AND pe.driverId = o.overtaken AND pe.lap = o.lap) IS NOT NULL
      THEN 'P'
      -- P: Pit exit - overtaken exited last lap
      WHEN (SELECT 1 FROM pit_exits px WHERE px.raceId = o.raceId AND px.driverId = o.overtaken AND px.lap = o.lap) IS NOT NULL
      THEN 'P'
      -- S: Start - first lap, within 2 grid slots
      WHEN o.lap = 1 AND (
        SELECT ABS(g1.grid - g2.grid)
        FROM race_start_grid g1
        JOIN race_start_grid g2 ON g1.raceId = g2.raceId
        WHERE g1.raceId = o.raceId AND g1.driverId = o.overtaker AND g2.driverId = o.overtaken
      ) <= 2
      THEN 'S'
      -- T: Track
      ELSE 'T'
    END AS label
  FROM overtake_candidates o
)
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY label;

WITH races_1950s AS (
  SELECT raceId, year
  FROM races
  WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
driver_season_constructors AS (
  SELECT
    r.year,
    dr.driverId,
    re.constructorId,
    r.raceId,
    re.round
  FROM results re
  INNER JOIN races_1950s r ON re.raceId = r.raceId
  INNER JOIN drivers dr ON re.driverId = dr.driverId
),
driver_season_races AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    driverId,
    re.constructorId,
    MIN(round) AS first_round,
    MAX(round) AS last_round,
    COUNT(DISTINCT re.raceId) AS num_races,
    MIN(re.constructorId) AS first_constructor,
    MAX(re.constructorId) AS last_constructor
  FROM driver_season_constructors re
  GROUP BY year, driverId
),
qualified_drivers AS (
  SELECT
    d.year,
    d.driverId
  FROM driver_season_races d
  WHERE d.num_races >= 2
    AND (
      SELECT constructorId
      FROM driver_season_constructors dsc
      WHERE dsc.driverId = d.driverId AND dsc.year = d.year AND dsc.round = d.first_round
      LIMIT 1
    ) = (
      SELECT constructorId
      FROM driver_season_constructors dsc
      WHERE dsc.driverId = d.driverId AND dsc.year = d.year AND dsc.round = d.last_round
      LIMIT 1
    )
)
SELECT DISTINCT dr.driverId, dr.surname, dr.forename
FROM qualified_drivers qd
JOIN drivers dr ON qd.driverId = dr.driverId
ORDER BY dr.surname, dr.forename;

WITH driver_race_appearances AS (
    SELECT
        d.driverId,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        r.year,
        r.round,
        results.constructorId,
        r.raceId
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results ON d.driverId = results.driverId
    JOIN races r ON results.raceId = r.raceId
),
driver_year_races AS (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        year,
        GROUP_CONCAT(round, ',') AS appeared_rounds,
        COUNT(DISTINCT round) AS num_appearances
    FROM driver_race_appearances
    GROUP BY driverId, year
),
all_race_rounds AS (
    SELECT
        r.year,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.round, ',') AS all_rounds,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.round) AS total_rounds
    FROM races r
    GROUP BY r.year
),
driver_missed_ranges AS (
    -- Find missed round ranges per driver per year, only where missed count < 3
    SELECT
        dra.driverId,
        dra.year,
        arr.all_rounds,
        dra.appeared_rounds,
        arr.total_rounds - dra.num_appearances AS num_missed,
        -- Parse rounds into arrays for later processing (first, last missed)
        arr.all_rounds AS all_rounds_csv,
        dra.appeared_rounds AS appeared_rounds_csv
    FROM driver_year_races dra
    JOIN all_race_rounds arr ON dra.year = arr.year
    WHERE (arr.total_rounds - dra.num_appearances) > 0 AND (arr.total_rounds - dra.num_appearances) < 3
),
expanded_missed_rounds AS (
    -- Expand missed rounds for each driver/year
    SELECT
        dmr.driverId,
        dmr.year,
        CAST(value AS INTEGER) AS missed_round
    FROM driver_missed_ranges dmr
    JOIN (
        SELECT
            driverId,
            year,
            all_rounds_csv,
            appeared_rounds_csv,
            -- split rounds into rows: for each round in all_rounds, if not in appeared_rounds, yield it
            substr(all_rounds_csv,
                instr(all_rounds_csv, ',') * (n - 1) + 1,
                CASE
                    WHEN instr(substr(all_rounds_csv || ',', instr(all_rounds_csv, ',') * (n - 1) + 1), ',') = 0 THEN length(all_rounds_csv)
                    ELSE instr(substr(all_rounds_csv || ',', instr(all_rounds_csv, ',') * (n - 1) + 1), ',') - 1
                END
            ) AS value
        FROM driver_missed_ranges
        JOIN (
            SELECT 1 as n UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7
            UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14
            UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20
            -- max races per year is 20 (should be enough)
        )
        WHERE n <= (length(all_rounds_csv) - length(REPLACE(all_rounds_csv, ',', ''))+1)
    ) AS rounds_split
    WHERE value NOT IN (SELECT value FROM (
        SELECT
            substr(appeared_rounds_csv,
                instr(appeared_rounds_csv, ',') * (n2 - 1) + 1,
                CASE
                    WHEN instr(substr(appeared_rounds_csv || ',', instr(appeared_rounds_csv, ',') * (n2 - 1) + 1), ',') = 0
                    THEN length(appeared_rounds_csv)
                    ELSE instr(substr(appeared_rounds_csv || ',', instr(appeared_rounds_csv, ',') * (n2 - 1) + 1), ',') - 1
                END
            ) AS value
        FROM (
            SELECT *
            FROM driver_missed_ranges AS t1
            WHERE t1.driverId = driver_missed_ranges.driverId AND t1.year = driver_missed_ranges.year
        ), (
            SELECT 1 AS n2 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION
            SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14
            UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20
        )
        WHERE n2 <= (length(appeared_rounds_csv) - length(REPLACE(appeared_rounds_csv, ',', ''))+1)
    ))
        AND value != '' AND value IS NOT NULL
),
driver_missed_ranges_final AS (
    -- collapse to one missed range per driver/year
    SELECT
        emr.driverId,
        emr.year,
        MIN(emr.missed_round) AS first_missed_round,
        MAX(emr.missed_round) AS last_missed_round
    FROM expanded_missed_rounds emr
    GROUP BY emr.driverId, emr.year
),
edge_constructor_switch AS (
    -- For each missed range, check constructor before/after missed races
    SELECT
        dmr.driverId,
        dmr.year,
        dmr.first_missed_round,
        dmr.last_missed_round,
        -- Get constructorId right before first missed
        (
            SELECT constructorId
            FROM driver_race_appearances dra
            WHERE dra.driverId = dmr.driverId
              AND dra.year = dmr.year
              AND dra.round = dmr.first_missed_round - 1
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS before_constructorId,
        -- Get constructorId right after last missed
        (
            SELECT constructorId
            FROM driver_race_appearances dra
            WHERE dra.driverId = dmr.driverId
              AND dra.year = dmr.year
              AND dra.round = dmr.last_missed_round + 1
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS after_constructorId
    FROM driver_missed_ranges_final dmr
    WHERE
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM driver_race_appearances dra
            WHERE dra.driverId = dmr.driverId AND dra.year = dmr.year AND dra.round = dmr.first_missed_round - 1
        )
        AND
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM driver_race_appearances dra
            WHERE dra.driverId = dmr.driverId AND dra.year = dmr.year AND dra.round = dmr.last_missed_round + 1
        )
)
SELECT
    AVG(first_missed_round * 1.0) AS avg_first_missed_round,
    AVG(last_missed_round * 1.0) AS avg_last_missed_round
FROM edge_constructor_switch
WHERE before_constructorId IS NOT NULL AND after_constructorId IS NOT NULL AND before_constructorId != after_constructorId;

WITH overtakes AS (
  SELECT
    lp.race_id,
    lp.lap,
    lp.position,
    lp.driver_id,
    LAG(lp.position) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_position,
    LAG(lp.lap) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_lap
  FROM lap_positions lp
),
position_changes AS (
  -- Only consider laps beyond the first lap (exclude start movements)
  -- Exclude pit-in/out laps by joining with pit_stops table
  SELECT
    o.race_id,
    o.lap,
    o.driver_id,
    o.prev_position,
    o.position,
    o.prev_lap
  FROM overtakes o
  LEFT JOIN pit_stops ps
    ON o.race_id = ps.race_id AND o.driver_id = ps.driver_id AND (o.lap = ps.lap or o.prev_lap = ps.lap)
  WHERE
    o.prev_lap IS NOT NULL
    AND o.lap > 1
    AND o.prev_position != o.position
    AND ps.driver_id IS NULL -- Exclude pit-in/out laps
),
all_drivers_in_lap AS (
  -- For each lap, find all driver positions before and after
  SELECT
    lp.race_id,
    lp.lap,
    lp.driver_id,
    lp.position
  FROM lap_positions lp
  WHERE lp.lap > 1
),
position_gains AS (
  -- Who overtook whom (i.e., a driver moving ahead of another)
  SELECT
    pc.race_id,
    pc.lap,
    pc.driver_id AS overtaker_id,
    pc.prev_position,
    pc.position,
    adil.driver_id AS overtaken_id
  FROM position_changes pc
  JOIN all_drivers_in_lap adil
    ON pc.race_id = adil.race_id
    AND pc.lap = adil.lap
    AND adil.driver_id != pc.driver_id
    AND pc.prev_position > adil.position -- Was behind previously
    AND pc.position <= adil.position -- Is now ahead or on same spot
),
overtake_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d1.driver_id,
    d1.forename || ' ' || d1.surname AS full_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT (pg.race_id || '_' || pg.lap || '_' || pg.overtaken_id)) AS overtakes_made
  FROM drivers d1
  LEFT JOIN position_gains pg
    ON d1.driver_id = pg.overtaker_id
  GROUP BY d1.driver_id
),
being_overtaken_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d1.driver_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT (pg.race_id || '_' || pg.lap || '_' || pg.overtaker_id)) AS overtakes_suffered
  FROM drivers d1
  LEFT JOIN position_gains pg
    ON d1.driver_id = pg.overtaken_id
  GROUP BY d1.driver_id
)
SELECT
  ods.full_name
FROM overtake_stats ods
JOIN being_overtaken_stats bos
  ON ods.driver_id = bos.driver_id
WHERE bos.overtakes_suffered > ods.overtakes_made
ORDER BY ods.full_name;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM mst_users
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY 
  CASE age_category
    WHEN '20s' THEN 1
    WHEN '30s' THEN 2
    WHEN '40s' THEN 3
    WHEN '50s' THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END

WITH first_action AS (
    SELECT
        session,
        MIN(id) AS first_special_id
    FROM activity_log
    WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/complete')
    GROUP BY session
),
pre_special_events AS (
    SELECT
        a.session,
        COUNT(*) AS pre_event_count
    FROM activity_log a
    LEFT JOIN first_action f
        ON a.session = f.session
    WHERE
        (a.search_type IS NOT NULL AND a.search_type != '')
        AND (f.first_special_id IS NULL OR a.id < f.first_special_id)
    GROUP BY a.session
),
min_count AS (
    SELECT MIN(pre_event_count) AS min_event_count
    FROM pre_special_events
)
SELECT
    a.session,
    a.path,
    a.search_type
FROM activity_log a
JOIN (
    SELECT
        p.session
    FROM pre_special_events p
    JOIN min_count m
      ON p.pre_event_count = m.min_event_count
) AS qualifying_sessions
  ON a.session = qualifying_sessions.session
LEFT JOIN first_action f
  ON a.session = f.session
WHERE
    (a.search_type IS NOT NULL AND a.search_type != '')
    AND (f.first_special_id IS NULL OR a.id < f.first_special_id)
ORDER BY a.session, a.id;
